definition_zh: 配额；定额；限额；（按比例分得的）份额
definition_en: a fixed share or amount assigned to a person, group or country, often acting as a limit
core_image: 一只大桶被分成若干等份，每只杯子只准取走贴着自己名字的那一份，多一滴也不行
scene: 合作社的分配会上，会计把全年的收购总量摊到各户，规定每户只能交售属于自己那一份的数量。At the cooperative meeting the accountant gave each household its quota of the yearly harvest.
sceneCN: 这里指「按规则分得的份额」，对应第 1 个义项：经事先划分后归某一方的定量；句意为会计在会上把全年收购量按户分配，每户只交售自己那一份。画面要点：分配桌、名册、等分的大桶。

pos.zh: 配额；定额；限额（可数，常与 import、sales、immigration 等连用）

derivatives.zh: 多份配额（quota 加复数后缀，语义由单份转为多份）
配额制度（quota 与 system 构成的复合词，指成套的配额安排）
配额抽样（quota 与 sampling 构成的复合术语，指按配额填格的抽样法）
以配额为基础的（quota 加 based 构成的复合形容词，指以配额为运作依据）
不受配额限制的（quota 加 free 构成的复合形容词，指免除配额约束）

senses.title: A share fixed by prior division
senses.titleCN: 事先划分后归某一方的定量
senses.definition: the part of a total that is measured out and assigned to one person or group in advance
senses.definitionCN: 总量中经事先量出并分配给某一个人或群体的那部分
senses.example: At the cooperative meeting the accountant gave each household its quota of the yearly harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 分配会上，会计把全年收购量按户分配，每户得到自己那一份。
senses.why: The Latin source is quota pars, literally 'how great a part', built on quot 'how many', so the word begins as a question about size answered by a fixed number.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语源是 quota pars，字面为「多大的一份」，由 quot「多少」构成；这个词最初就是对大小的提问，答案是一个定数。

senses.title: An official ceiling on imports
senses.titleCN: 官方设定的进口数量上限
senses.definition: a limit set by a government on the quantity of a good that may be imported
senses.definitionCN: 政府规定的某类商品可以进口的数量上限
senses.example: The government placed a quota on imported steel.
senses.exampleCN: 政府对进口钢材设定了配额。
senses.why: Once a share is fixed by authority rather than by custom, it stops being an entitlement and becomes a wall that trade cannot pass.
senses.whyCN: 当份额由官方而不是惯例来确定，它就不再是应得之份，而变成贸易越不过的一道墙。

senses.title: A required output target
senses.titleCN: 必须完成的产量或销售定额
senses.definition: the amount of work, output or sales that a worker or team is required to reach
senses.definitionCN: 要求员工或团队达到的工作量、产量或销售量
senses.example: Sales staff must meet a monthly quota before bonuses are paid.
senses.exampleCN: 销售人员必须先完成月度定额才能拿到奖金。
senses.why: The same fixed number can be read from below: what was a ceiling for imports becomes a floor that output must reach.
senses.whyCN: 同一个定数也可以从下方读：进口的上限，反过来成了产出必须够到的下限。

senses.title: A limit on the number admitted
senses.titleCN: 准予进入的人数上限
senses.definition: the maximum number of people allowed into a country, school or programme in a period
senses.definitionCN: 在一定时期内允许进入某国、某校或某项目的最多人数
senses.example: The university keeps a quota for students from overseas.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学为海外学生保留了固定名额。
senses.why: Counting people rather than goods needs the same instrument: a number agreed beforehand keeps demand from overflowing the gate.
senses.whyCN: 数人与数货物需要同一种工具：事先商定的数字，使需求不会把门挤破。

senses.title: A fixed contribution owed by a member
senses.titleCN: 成员应缴的固定份额
senses.definition: the set portion of a common cost or supply that each member is obliged to provide
senses.definitionCN: 共同费用或物资中每一成员必须承担的那一份
senses.example: Each branch pays its quota of the association's running costs.
senses.exampleCN: 每个分会承担协会运转费用中属于自己的那一份。
senses.why: When the direction of the flow reverses, the assigned part turns into an obligation: the member owes the number instead of receiving it.
senses.whyCN: 当流向反转，被分配的那一份就变成义务：成员不再是领取这个数字，而是欠下这个数字。

senses.title: A proportional share of posts or seats
senses.titleCN: 按比例保留的席位或职位
senses.definition: a number of places reserved for a category of people in an assembly, workforce or list
senses.definitionCN: 在议会、员工队伍或名单中为某类人预留的席位数
senses.example: The party reserved a quota of seats for women candidates.
senses.exampleCN: 该党为女性候选人保留了固定比例的席位。
senses.why: Division by proportion is the oldest use of the word, and reserved seats are simply that proportion written into a rulebook.
senses.whyCN: 按比例划分是这个词最古老的用法，保留席位不过是把这一比例写进了规则手册。

senses.title: Quota sampling in research
senses.titleCN: 研究中的配额抽样
senses.definition: a sampling method that fills each category of a population up to a preset number
senses.definitionCN: 按预设数目把总体中每一类填满的抽样方法
senses.example: The survey used quota sampling to fill each age band.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查用配额抽样填满各个年龄段。
senses.why: Statistics borrowed the word because the sample is built the way a shipment is built: each cell gets exactly its assigned count.
senses.whyCN: 统计学借用这个词，因为样本的搭建方式如同配货：每个格子里都正好放进被分配的数量。

senses.title: Any measured portion, even of non-material things
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：连非实体之物也被量出的那一份
senses.definition: an allotted amount of something abstract, such as luck, patience or misfortune
senses.definitionCN: 某种抽象之物（如运气、耐心或不幸）被分定的量
senses.example: Every generation seems to have its quota of hardship.
senses.exampleCN: 每一代人似乎都有自己那一份艰难。
senses.why: The abstract sense keeps the arithmetic but drops the goods: whatever can be counted out can also be allotted.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义保留了算术，却去掉了货物：凡能被数出来的东西，也都能被分配。

intro.en: Quota is Latin for 'how great a part'. It is the feminine of quotus 'of what number', from quot 'how many', and it entered English through legal and commercial counting. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: quota 在拉丁语中意为「多大的一份」，是 quotus「第几、若干」的阴性形式，源头为 quot「多少」；它经法律与商业的计算进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Quot was an indeclinable question word meaning 'how many', used in reckoning and in legal formulas.
items.cn: quot 是一个不变化的疑问词，意为「多少」，用于计算与法律套语。

items.en: Quotus 'of what number, which in order' supplied the adjective, and its feminine quota came to mean the part so numbered.
items.cn: quotus 意为「第几的、若干的」，提供形容词；其阴性形式 quota 后来指被这样编号的那一份。

items.en: Legal and estate records used quota pars, literally 'how great a part', for a share fixed by agreement or custom.
items.cn: 法律与田产记录用 quota pars，字面为「多大的一份」，指按协议或惯例定下的份额。

items.en: English took quota as a proportional share, first in accounts and taxation, then in any fixed allowance.
items.cn: 英语在大约 1600 年吸收 quota 表示按比例分得的份额，最初用于账目与税赋，后泛指任何固定配给。

items.en: Immigration quotas in the 1920s and import quotas in the 1930s fixed the modern sense of an official numerical limit; quota sampling followed from the same counting habit.
items.cn: 1920 年代的移民配额与 1930 年代的进口配额，确定了现代「官方数量上限」这一义；配额抽样则出自同一种计数的习惯。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin counting root but diverged in meaning; the second group offers near alternatives for the idea of an allotted amount.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语「计数」词根，但语义已分岔；第二组是「被分配的份额」这一意思的近义替代。

entries.definition: To repeat someone's words or to state a price; it comes from the same counting root but the action is marking or citing, not allotting.
entries.definitionCN: 引用他人的话或报出价格；同出「计数」词根，但动作是标出或引述，而不是分配。

entries.definition: A cited passage or a stated price; the counting root survives only in the idea of marking something down.
entries.definitionCN: 被引用的段落或报出的价格；计数词根只剩「把它标记下来」这一层。

entries.definition: The result of a division; it keeps the 'how many times' question but names an answer in arithmetic, never a share.
entries.definitionCN: 除法所得的结果；它保留「多少次」的提问，但指的是算术答案，从不指份额。

entries.definition: A fixed allowance of food or supplies, from Latin ratio 'reckoning', not from quot; it looks close but belongs to another family.
entries.definitionCN: 食物或物资的定额配给，出自拉丁语 ratio「计算」，并非 quot；形近而属于另一词族。

entries.definition: A portion belonging to one party; it states the division but not that the amount was fixed in advance by an authority.
entries.definitionCN: 属于某一方的部分；它只说划分，不说这个数量是由权威事先定下的。

entries.definition: An amount permitted to a person, often for expenses; it stresses permission rather than proportional division.
entries.definitionCN: 允许某人使用的量，常指费用；它强调许可，而不是按比例划分。

entries.definition: A maximum that may not be exceeded; it captures the limit sense of quota but not the idea of a fair share.
entries.definitionCN: 不得超过的最高限度；它涵盖配额的限额义，但不含「公平一份」的意思。

entries.definition: The process or result of assigning resources; it names the act, while quota names the measured amount.
entries.definitionCN: 分配资源的过程或结果；它指动作，而配额指被量出的数额。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real counting root, the real derived words and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「计数」词根、真实的派生词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Quot means 'how many', so quota is the answer to 'how many for you'.
normal.cn: quot 意为「多少」，quota 就是「你那份是多少」的答案。

normal.en: The same root shows in quotient and quotation, both about counting or marking a number.
normal.cn: 同一词根见于 quotient 与 quotation，两者都与计数或标号有关。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the limit sense: import quota, sales quota, immigration quota.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出限额义：进口配额、销售定额、移民配额。

normal.en: A quota is always a count, never a price: it answers how many, not how much money.
normal.cn: 配额总是数量，不是价格：它回答「多少个」，不回答「多少钱」。

normal.en: The word implies that someone has already done the splitting before you arrive.
normal.cn: 这个词隐含：在你到场之前，已经有人把总量分好了。

abstract.en: Picture a pie cut into equal wedges, each wedge tagged with a name before anyone lifts a fork.
abstract.cn: 想象一块馅饼被切成等份，每份在有人动叉之前就贴上了名字。

abstract.en: Picture a theatre with a block of seats roped off, the rope saying who may sit there.
abstract.cn: 想象剧院里有一排座位被绳子围住，绳子说明了谁可以坐。

abstract.en: Picture a queue at a gate where a counter clicks once for each person and stops at a set number.
abstract.cn: 想象门口排队，计数器每进一人跳一下，到某个数就停住。

examples.en: The fishing fleet exceeded its annual quota by two thousand tonnes.
examples.cn: 捕鱼船队超出年度配额两千吨。

examples.en: A quota on imports pushed buyers toward domestic suppliers.
examples.cn: 进口配额把买家推向国内供应商。

examples.en: She hit her sales quota three weeks before the quarter ended.
examples.cn: 她在季度结束前三周就完成了销售定额。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「括住一份」——先把总量括成若干份，你只拿写着你名字的那一份 → 配额、定额

root: 拉丁 quot「多少」→ quotus「第几、若干」→ quota（pars）「多大的一份」；英语 quota 即「按规则划出的那一份」，同根词有 quotient、quote、quotation。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all rest on one act: a total is measured out before it is used. The measured part then becomes an import ceiling, an output target, an admission cap, a member's contribution, a reserved block of seats, a sampling cell and finally any countable allotment.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都立在一个动作上：总量在被使用之前先被量出。这份量出之物随后成为进口上限、产出目标、准入人数上限、成员应缴份额、保留席位、抽样格子，最后扩展到任何可数的分配。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a barrel divided into equal parts, each cup taking only the part marked with its name.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只桶被分成等份，每只杯子只取贴着它名字的那一份。

branches.en: BASE SHARE: one measured part of a whole, assigned rather than chosen.
branches.cn: 基础份额：整体中被量出的一份，由他人指派而非自己挑选。

branches.en: LIMIT AND TARGET: the assigned number becomes a wall for imports or a floor for output.
branches.cn: 上限与目标：被指派的数量，对进口是墙，对产出是底线。

branches.en: RULES OF ENTRY: a count of people admitted, or a block of seats reserved by proportion.
branches.cn: 准入规则：限定可进入的人数，或按比例预留一批席位。

branches.en: OBLIGATION: the same number reverses direction and becomes what a member owes.
branches.cn: 义务：同一个数字反转方向，成为成员应缴的部分。

branches.en: COUNTING EXTENDED: sampling fills cells by number, and even hardship can be allotted.
branches.cn: 计数外扩：抽样按数目填格，连艰难也能被分配。

intro.en: Quota is a Latin noun built on a question word, and that question word also built several English terms about numbering.
intro.cn: quota 是由一个疑问词构成的拉丁名词，这个疑问词还构成若干英语中与计数有关的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin quot 'how many' gives quota, quotient, quote and quotation, though the last two moved from counting to marking and citing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 quot「多少」衍生 quota、quotient、quote 与 quotation，后两者已从计数转向标记与引述。

items.example: The element asks a question about quantity.
items.exampleCN: 这个成分提出的是关于数量的问题。

items.structure: quota (from quota pars, how great a part)
items.exampleCN: 每户都领到了自己那份配额。

items.example: Import quotas were raised this year.
items.exampleCN: 今年的进口配额提高了。

items.example: Divide the total by six to get the quotient.

items.structure: quote (same root, to mark or cite)
items.meaning: to repeat words or state a price
items.exampleCN: 她直接引用了那份报告。

items.meaning: a cited passage or a price offer
items.example: The quotation was valid for thirty days.
The speech had one quotable line.
items.exampleCN: 这篇演讲有一句值得引用的话。

items.meaning: a method filling categories by set counts
items.meaningCN: 按设定数目填满类别的抽样方法
items.example: Quota sampling kept the age groups balanced.
items.exampleCN: 配额抽样使各年龄组保持平衡。

latinEntries.meaning: of what number; which in order

latinEntries.structure: quota (feminine of quotus, used as a noun)

definition_zh: 进口；输入；引进（思想、方法、数据）；（复数）进口货物；含义；重要性
definition_en: to bring goods, data or ideas in from another country or system; also the goods so brought in
core_image: 一艘货轮靠上本国码头，吊机把贴着外文标签的箱子从船舱搬进关栈
scene: 港口的海关大厅里，报关员核对一票从海外运来的咖啡豆，把它们登记为进入本国的货物。The customs officer cleared a shipment of coffee that the firm chose to import from abroad.
sceneCN: 这里指「把境外货物运进本国」，对应第 1 个义项：以购买或运入的方式让外国商品进入本国市场；句意为报关员为一票从海外运来的咖啡豆办理进境手续。画面要点：码头吊机、关栈、贴着外文标签的货箱。

pos.zh: 进口；输入；引进（动词重音在后）
进口货物；进口（名词重音在前，常用复数 imports）
含义；重要性（正式书面语，不可数）

derivatives.zh: 进口商（import 加表示施动者的后缀，指从事进口的一方）
进口行为（import 加表示动作或结果的后缀，语义偏向过程本身）
进口的（import 加过去分词后缀作形容词，指已经运入的）
进口活动（import 加现在分词后缀作名词，指持续进行的进口）
可进口的（import 加表示可能的形容词后缀，指允许或能够输入）

senses.title: Bring goods into a country for sale
senses.titleCN: 把外国货物运进本国销售
senses.definition: to buy or bring in goods from another country, usually for sale or processing
senses.definitionCN: 从另一国购买或运入货物，通常用于销售或加工
senses.example: The firm imports coffee from three tropical countries.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司从三个热带国家进口咖啡。
senses.why: Latin importare is in- 'into' plus portare 'to carry', so the verb is literally to carry something inward across a boundary.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 importare 由 in-「向内」加 portare「搬运」构成，动词字面就是把东西搬过边界、送进里面。

senses.title: Bring in a material or living thing from outside
senses.titleCN: 从境外输入原料、动植物或能源
senses.definition: to bring in a raw material, animal, plant or form of energy from outside the country
senses.definitionCN: 从本国之外输入原料、动物、植物或能源
senses.example: The country imports most of the fertiliser its farms need.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家农场所需的化肥大部分靠进口。
senses.why: The same carrying motion applies to anything that crosses a border, not only to goods sold in shops.
senses.whyCN: 同一个搬运动作适用于任何跨越国界之物，并不只限于商店出售的商品。

senses.title: Bring in ideas, methods or people
senses.titleCN: 引进思想、做法或人员
senses.definition: to adopt and bring in practices, ideas or workers from another country or field
senses.definitionCN: 从另一国或另一领域采纳并引入做法、观念或人员
senses.example: The school imports teaching methods from abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校从国外引进教学方法。
senses.why: Once the boundary is not a customs line but a cultural one, the verb still means carrying something in from outside.
senses.whyCN: 当边界不再是海关线而是文化界线，这个动词仍然指从外面把东西搬进来。

senses.title: Transfer data into a program
senses.titleCN: 把数据导入程序
senses.definition: to load data from an outside file or system into an application
senses.definitionCN: 把外部文件或系统中的数据载入某个应用程序
senses.example: Import the spreadsheet into the database before running the report.
senses.exampleCN: 运行报表之前先把表格导入数据库。
senses.why: Computing reused the customs metaphor: the file comes from outside the program and is carried in.
senses.whyCN: 计算机沿用海关的比喻：文件来自程序之外，被搬进程序里面。

senses.title: Goods brought in from abroad
senses.titleCN: 从境外运入的货物（复数名词）
senses.definition: goods bought from another country, usually counted in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 从另一国买来的货物，通常以复数计
senses.example: Imports rose faster than exports last quarter.
senses.exampleCN: 上季度进口增长快于出口。
senses.why: English often turns an action into a countable noun, so the thing carried in is simply an import.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把动作转为可数名词，于是被搬进来的东西就直接叫作进口货物。

senses.title: The activity or business of importing
senses.titleCN: 进口这一行为或行业
senses.definition: the trade or process of bringing goods into a country, considered as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 把货物运入本国的贸易或过程，作为一个整体来看
senses.example: Import is taxed at the border while export is largely free.
senses.exampleCN: 进口在边境征税，出口则基本免税。
senses.why: The uncountable use names the flow rather than the objects, which is why it appears in policy and statistics.
senses.whyCN: 不可数用法指这股流动而非物件，因此常见于政策与统计语境。

senses.title: To mean or signify
senses.titleCN: 意为；含有……的意思（正式）
senses.definition: to carry a certain meaning or implication, used of words, signs or clauses
senses.definitionCN: 带有某种含义或暗示，用于词语、符号或条款
senses.example: What does this clause import for small suppliers?
senses.exampleCN: 这一条款对小供应商意味着什么？
senses.why: Something carried in can be meaning rather than cargo, and this formal sense survives in legal and literary English.
senses.whyCN: 被带进来的可以是含义而不是货物，这一正式义仍存于法律与文学英语中。

senses.title: Importance or consequence
senses.titleCN: 重要性；分量（正式）
senses.definition: the weight or consequence that something carries
senses.definitionCN: 某事物所具有的分量或后果
senses.example: The wording is a matter of great import to both sides.
senses.exampleCN: 这一措辞对双方都是极有分量的事。
senses.why: From 'carrying weight' it was a short step to 'having weight', so import came to name significance itself.
senses.whyCN: 从「承载分量」到「具有分量」只差一步，import 于是直接指重要性。

intro.en: Import comes from Latin importare 'to bring in, convey', built on in- 'into' and portare 'to carry'. The deeper origin of portare is usually reconstructed rather than attested. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: import 出自拉丁 importare「带入、运送」，由 in-「向内」与 portare「搬运」构成；portare 更深来源多为重构形式，而非有书证的形式。年代均为约数。

items.en: Portare meant 'to carry, convey, transport'. Its pre-Latin source is generally reconstructed as a root meaning 'to lead or pass over', so the form offered for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: portare 意为「搬运、运送、运输」。其拉丁语之前的来源一般被重构为一个表示「引导、越过」的词根，因此为其给出的形式属重构形式。

items.en: In- 'into' plus portare gave importare 'to bring in, introduce, convey', used of goods and of meaning alike.
items.cn: in-「向内」加 portare 构成 importare「带入、引入、运送」，既用于货物也用于含义。

items.en: English borrowed import directly from Latin, first as a verb of conveying and then as a noun of consequence.
items.cn: 英语直接从拉丁语借入 import，最初是表示运送的动词，随后又作表示分量的名词。

items.en: By the sixteenth century the word was fixed in trade for goods brought from another country, and the plural imports named them.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，这个词在贸易中固定指从另一国运来的货物，复数 imports 用来指这些货物。

items.en: Twentieth-century computing extended the customs image to files and data carried into a program.
items.cn: 20 世纪的计算机把海关的意象扩展到被搬进程序的文件与数据。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin carrying root but has split into different meanings; the second group contains words that also express bringing something in.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语「搬运」词根，但已分化为不同意思；第二组是同样表示「把东西带进来」的词。

entries.definition: Ex- 'out' plus portare: to carry goods out of a country, the mirror image of import.
entries.definitionCN: ex-「向外」加 portare：把货物运出本国，是 import 的镜像。

entries.definition: From the same Latin verb, but it describes something carrying weight or consequence, not goods crossing a border.
entries.definitionCN: 同出这个拉丁动词，但形容某物有分量、有后果，而非货物过境。

entries.definition: Portare plus -able: able to be carried, with no direction and no border.
entries.definitionCN: portare 加 -able：能被携带，不含方向，也不含边界。

entries.definition: Trans- 'across' plus portare: to carry from one place to another within or beyond a country.
entries.definitionCN: trans-「穿过」加 portare：把东西从一处运到另一处，可在国内也可跨境。

entries.definition: The ordinary phrase for carrying something inside; import is its formal and commercial counterpart.
entries.definitionCN: 把东西带进来的日常说法；import 是其正式、商业化的对应词。

entries.definition: To bring something in for the first time, as a practice or species; import stresses the crossing of a boundary, not novelty.
entries.definitionCN: 首次引入某做法或物种；import 强调的是越过边界，而不是新鲜。

entries.definition: To purchase in a foreign market; it names the money side, while import names the movement of goods.
entries.definitionCN: 在外国市场购买；它指付钱的一面，而 import 指货物的移动。

entries.definition: To bring goods by ship or carrier; it covers logistics but not the legal act of importation.
entries.definitionCN: 用船或承运人运进；它覆盖物流，却不含进口的法律行为。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real carrying root, real derived words and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「搬运」词根、真实的派生词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: In- 'into' + portare 'carry': to carry inward, across a border.
normal.cn: in-「向内」+ portare「搬运」：把东西往里面搬，越过边界。

normal.en: The family runs import, importer, importation, important and importance.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 import、importer、importation、important 与 importance。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the trade sense: import duty, import quota, import licence.
normal.cn: 固定搭配显示贸易义：进口关税、进口配额、进口许可证。

normal.en: The same root appears in export, transport and portable, all through portare.
normal.cn: 同一词根见于 export、transport 与 portable，都经 portare。

normal.en: Noun stress moves forward, verb stress stays back: an IMport is the cargo, to imPORT is the act.
normal.cn: 名词重音前移，动词重音后置：名词指货物，动词指动作。

abstract.en: Picture a door in a wall where everything entering must be weighed and written down.
abstract.cn: 想象墙上一道门，凡进入之物都要过秤并登记。

abstract.en: Picture a suitcase opened at a border, its contents counted rather than priced.
abstract.cn: 想象边境上一只打开的箱子，里面东西被清点而不是被估价。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence carrying a hidden weight that only the listener feels.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话带着看不见的分量，只有听者能感到。

examples.en: The country imports nearly all of its oil.
examples.cn: 这个国家的石油几乎全靠进口。

examples.en: Imports of electrical goods fell after the tariff rose.
examples.cn: 关税上调后，电器进口下降。

examples.en: You can import the survey data directly into the analysis tool.
examples.cn: 你可以把调查数据直接导入分析工具。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「往里搬」——in 是往里，port 是搬，把外国货往本国码头搬 → 进口

root: 拉丁 importare「带入」= in-（向内）+ portare「搬运」；portare 更深来源为重构形式。英语 import 兼指进口货物、含义与重要性。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one motion, carrying something inward. It begins at a customs line, widens to materials and ideas, moves into software, then leaves the warehouse altogether as the carried thing becomes meaning and finally weight.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一个动作展开：把东西往里面搬。它从海关线开始，扩展到原料与观念，再进入软件，最后离开仓库，被搬的东西变成含义，进而变成分量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crane lifting foreign crates from a ship into a bonded warehouse.
core.cn: 核心意象：吊机把外国货箱从船上吊进保税仓库。

branches.en: BASE MOTION: goods are carried across a border for sale.
branches.cn: 基础动作：货物越过边界被搬进来销售。

branches.en: WIDER CARGO: the same motion brings fertiliser, animals, methods and people.
branches.cn: 更宽的货：同一动作也运来化肥、动物、做法与人。

branches.en: DATA INTAKE: the border becomes the edge of a program.
branches.cn: 数据入口：边界变成程序的边缘。

branches.en: COUNTED FLOW: the act becomes countable cargo, then an uncountable trade.
branches.cn: 可数的流动：动作变成可数的货物，再变成不可数的行业。

branches.en: MEANING AND WEIGHT: what is carried in is significance itself.
branches.cn: 含义与分量：被搬进来的就是意义本身。

intro.en: Import is built from a Latin prefix and a Latin verb that also build a large family of English carrying words.
intro.cn: import 由一个拉丁前缀与一个拉丁动词构成，这两部分还构成一大族英语中表示搬运的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin portare 'to carry' gives import, export, transport, portable and porter, while in- marks the direction inward.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 portare「搬运」衍生 import、export、transport、portable 与 porter，in- 则标出向内的方向。

items.example: The prefix turns carrying into bringing in.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把「搬」变成「搬进来」。

items.example: The root carries the idea of moving a load.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着「移动一担货物」的意思。
他们每年冬天进口谷物。

items.meaning: goods brought in, or the act in the third person
items.meaningCN: 运入的货物，或第三人称的动作

items.meaning: a firm or person that imports
items.example: The importer paid the duty at the port.
items.exampleCN: 进口商在港口缴纳了关税。

items.meaning: the act of bringing goods in
items.example: Importation of the seed is restricted.
items.exampleCN: 这种种子的进口受到限制。

items.example: The date is important for both sides.
items.exampleCN: 这个日期对双方都很重要。

items.example: The report stressed the importance of timing.
items.exampleCN: 报告强调了时机的重要性。

items.example: The device is small and portable.
They export wool to three markets.
items.exampleCN: 他们把羊毛出口到三个市场。

definition_zh: 进口商；进口国；报关进口方；导入程序或导入工具
definition_en: a person, firm or country that brings goods or data in from outside
core_image: 码头办公室里的一个人，手里拿着到货清单，在每一箱外国货物上盖章签字，承担它们进境后的责任
scene: 报关大厅里，一位商人拿着到货清单在每箱外国咖啡上盖章，承担货物进境后的全部责任。The importer signed for every crate and accepted liability once the goods entered the country.
sceneCN: 这里指「承担进口责任的进口商」，对应第 1 个义项：从境外购入货物并办理进境手续的一方；句意为这位进口商逐箱签收，并对货物入境后的责任负责。画面要点：报关台、到货清单、印章、贴外文标签的箱子。

pos.zh: 进口商；进口方（可数，指公司、个人或国家）

derivatives.zh: 进口（importer 的基础动词，去掉施动后缀即得，指把货物搬入）
进口行为（import 加表示动作的名词后缀，指过程而非人）
可进口的（import 加表示可能的形容词后缀，指允许或能够输入）
多个进口方（importer 加复数后缀，语义由单方转为多方）
净进口方（net 加 importer 构成的复合说法，指进口大于出口的一方）

senses.title: A firm that buys goods abroad
senses.titleCN: 从境外购入货物的公司
senses.definition: a business that purchases goods in another country and brings them in for sale or use
senses.definitionCN: 在另一国购货并运入本国销售或使用的企业
senses.example: The importer signed for every crate and accepted liability once the goods entered the country.
senses.exampleCN: 这位进口商逐箱签收，并对货物入境后的责任负责。
senses.why: Import is the act of carrying goods in, and the agent suffix marks the party that performs it, so importer is simply 'the one who brings in'.
senses.whyCN: import 是把货物搬进来的动作，施动后缀标出执行这个动作的一方，因此 importer 就是「把货搬进来的那一个」。

senses.title: A country that buys more than it sells
senses.titleCN: 进口大于出口的国家或地区
senses.definition: a country or region whose purchases from abroad exceed its sales abroad
senses.definitionCN: 从境外购入多于向外售出的国家或地区
senses.example: The region is a net importer of grain and a net exporter of machinery.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区是粮食净进口方、机械净出口方。
senses.why: Trade statistics count flows rather than firms, so the same word is applied to a whole economy that behaves like a buyer.
senses.whyCN: 贸易统计计的是流量而不是公司，于是同一个词被用到整体经济上，把国家当作买方。

senses.title: The party legally responsible at customs
senses.titleCN: 在海关承担法律责任的报关进口方
senses.definition: the party registered as legally responsible for a shipment entering the country
senses.definitionCN: 在货物进境时被登记为承担法律责任的一方
senses.example: Customs holds the importer of record answerable for the declared value.
senses.exampleCN: 海关要求报关进口方对申报价值负责。
senses.why: A shipment needs one name on the form, so the trade role became a legal status with duties attached.
senses.whyCN: 一票货物需要在表格上填一个名字，于是贸易角色变成了附带义务的法律身份。

senses.title: A buyer of power or fuel from another grid
senses.titleCN: 从其他电网或市场购电、购燃料的一方
senses.definition: a utility, region or country that purchases electricity or fuel from outside its own system
senses.definitionCN: 从本系统之外购买电力或燃料的公用事业、地区或国家
senses.example: The country became an importer of electricity after the drought.
senses.exampleCN: 旱灾之后，这个国家成了电力进口方。
senses.why: Energy crosses borders like cargo, and the entity on the receiving end takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 能源像货物一样跨越边界，接收一端的实体也得到同一个称呼。

senses.title: A tool that brings data into software
senses.titleCN: 把数据带进软件的工具或程序
senses.definition: a routine or feature that loads data from an outside file or system into an application
senses.definitionCN: 把外部文件或系统中的数据载入某个应用的程序或功能
senses.example: The importer converted the old records into the new format.
senses.exampleCN: 导入程序把旧记录转换成了新格式。
senses.why: Software personifies the routine that performs the carrying, so a data tool takes the agent label.
senses.whyCN: 软件把执行搬运的程序当作施动者，于是数据工具也用这个施动标签。

senses.title: A person or body that brings in ideas
senses.titleCN: 把外来观念或做法带进来的人或机构
senses.definition: a person, school or organization that introduces practices or ideas from elsewhere
senses.definitionCN: 从别处引入做法或观念的个人、学校或机构
senses.example: The college acted as an importer of foreign teaching methods.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学院充当了外国教学方法的引入者。
senses.why: When the cargo is cultural, the agent noun still names whoever does the carrying.
senses.whyCN: 当货物是文化时，这个施动名词仍然指做搬运的那个人。

senses.title: A buyer of live plants or animals from abroad
senses.titleCN: 从境外购入活体动植物的一方
senses.definition: a nursery, dealer or institution that brings living organisms in from another country
senses.definitionCN: 从另一国运入活体生物的苗圃、经销商或机构
senses.example: The plant importer needed a health certificate for every batch.
senses.exampleCN: 这家植物进口商每批货都需要检疫证书。
senses.why: Living cargo adds risk, so this sense usually appears beside permits and inspections.
senses.whyCN: 活体货物带来额外风险，因此这个义项常与许可证和检验一道出现。

senses.title: The buying side of a trade contract
senses.titleCN: 贸易合同中的买方一方
senses.definition: the party in a sales contract that buys and receives the goods
senses.definitionCN: 买卖合同中购买并接收货物的一方
senses.example: The importer bears the freight cost under this contract.
senses.exampleCN: 按此合同，进口方承担运费。
senses.why: Contracts name roles rather than activities, so importer becomes a shorthand for the buyer who takes delivery.
senses.whyCN: 合同标的是角色而不是活动，于是 importer 成为「接货买方」的简称。

intro.en: Importer is import plus the English agent suffix -er, so its history is the history of the verb plus the history of naming the doer. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: importer 是 import 加英语施动后缀 -er 构成，它的历史就是动词的历史加上「为做者命名」的历史。年代均为约数。

items.en: Importare 'to bring in' supplied the verb, built on in- 'into' and portare 'to carry'.
items.cn: importare「带入」提供动词，由 in-「向内」与 portare「搬运」构成。

items.en: The suffix -er comes from Old English -ere, the native way of naming a person or thing that performs an action.
items.cn: 后缀 -er 出自古英语 -ere，是英语本族为「执行某动作的人或物」命名的方式。

items.en: As import settled into commerce, importer named the merchant who paid for and received foreign goods.
items.cn: 随着 import 在商业中固定下来，importer 指付款购买并接收外国货物的商人。

items.en: Customs codes later turned the word into a legal status, the party of record answerable for duty and declaration.
items.cn: 海关法规随后把这个词变成一种法律身份，即对关税与申报负责的登记方。

items.en: Economists applied it to whole countries, and computing applied it to routines that load outside data.
items.cn: 经济学家把它用到整个国家，计算机则把它用到载入外部数据的程序上。

note.en: The first group shares the carrying root or the agent form; the second group names parties that also buy or receive goods.
note.cn: 第一组共享「搬运」词根或施动形式；第二组是同样购买或接收货物的一方。

entries.definition: The act itself; adding the suffix is what turns the act into a party.
entries.definitionCN: 动作本身；加上后缀才把动作变成一方。

entries.definition: The process of bringing goods in; it names the procedure, while importer names who performs it.
entries.definitionCN: 把货物运入的过程；它指程序，而 importer 指执行程序的人。

entries.definition: The same suffix on the opposite prefix: the party that sells goods outward.
entries.definitionCN: 同一后缀加相反前缀：把货物向外卖出的一方。

entries.definition: An adjective about weight and consequence, built from the same verb but naming no party at all.
entries.definitionCN: 表示分量与后果的形容词，同出这个动词，却不指任何一方。

entries.definition: Anyone who pays for goods; importer adds the crossing of a national border.
entries.definitionCN: 任何付钱买货的人；importer 额外带上跨越国界这一层。

entries.definition: The party named to receive a shipment; it may be the importer or an agent acting for one.
entries.definitionCN: 被指定接收货物的一方；它可能是进口商，也可能是替进口商行事的代理人。

entries.definition: A firm that spreads imported goods through a local market; importing is only part of its work.
entries.definitionCN: 把进口货物分销到本地市场的公司；进口只是其工作的一部分。

entries.definition: A person who buys on behalf of a firm; the legal importer may still be the firm, not the agent.
entries.definitionCN: 替公司采购的人；法律上的进口方仍可能是公司而非这位代理。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real verb, the real agent suffix and real trade roles.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的动词、真实的施动后缀与真实的贸易角色。

normal.en: Import plus -er: the person or firm that does the carrying in.
normal.cn: import 加 -er：做「搬进来」这件事的人或公司。

normal.en: The suffix -er is the native English way of making doers, as in buyer, seller and carrier.
normal.cn: 后缀 -er 是英语本族构成施动者的方式，如 buyer、seller 与 carrier。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the roles: net importer, major importer, importer of record.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出角色：净进口方、主要进口商、报关进口方。

normal.en: The counterpart is exporter, the same suffix on the opposite prefix.
normal.cn: 对应词是 exporter，同一后缀加在相反的前缀上。

normal.en: An importer is a party, so it can sign, be taxed and be held liable.
normal.cn: 进口商是一方，因此它能签字、被征税、被追责。

abstract.en: Picture one name written on a customs form while a whole shipment depends on it.
abstract.cn: 想象报关单上只写着一个名字，而整票货物都系于此。

abstract.en: Picture a country drawn as a single buyer standing at a border with an empty basket.
abstract.cn: 想象一个国家被画成一个站在边境、提着空篮子的买方。

abstract.en: Picture a small program opening a door for a file that has never been inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小程序为一从未进过门内的文件打开一道门。

examples.en: The importer paid the duty before the container left the port.
examples.cn: 进口商在集装箱离港前缴清了关税。

examples.en: Japan is a large importer of liquefied gas.
examples.cn: 日本是液化天然气的进口大国。

examples.en: The importer of record must keep the invoices for five years.
examples.cn: 报关进口方必须把发票保存五年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「往里搬的人」——import 是搬进来，加个表示人的尾巴，就是负责搬进来的那一方 → 进口商

root: import「进口」+ -er（英语本族施动后缀，源自古英语 -ere），指执行进口这一动作的人、公司或国家；同根动词出自拉丁 importare。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all name a party rather than an act: a firm, a national economy, a customs debtor, an energy buyer, a software routine, a cultural borrower, a live-cargo dealer and the buyer in a contract.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项指的都是某一方而不是动作：公司、国家经济、海关义务人、能源买方、软件程序、文化借用者、活体货物经销商，以及合同中的买方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one person at a port signing for every crate that enters.
core.cn: 核心意象：港口边一个人为每一只进境货箱签字。

branches.en: BASE DOER: the agent suffix turns carrying in into a business role.
branches.cn: 基础施动者：施动后缀把「搬进来」变成一个商业角色。

branches.en: WHOLE ECONOMIES: a country or grid behaves like a single buyer.
branches.cn: 整体经济：国家或电网被当作单一买方。

branches.en: LEGAL PARTY: customs and contracts need one named party to carry liability.
branches.cn: 法律一方：海关与合同都需要一个具名的一方来承担责任。

branches.en: SYSTEM INTAKE: software names its loading routine as a doer.
branches.cn: 系统入口：软件把载入程序也称作一个施动者。

branches.en: NON-GOODS CARGO: ideas and living organisms are carried in by the same kind of party.
branches.cn: 非货物之货：观念与活体生物也由同类一方搬入。

intro.en: Importer is a transparent two-part word: a Latin verb of carrying plus a native English suffix for doers.
intro.cn: importer 是一个结构透明的两段式词：拉丁语表示搬运的动词，加上英语本族的施动后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin portare 'to carry' supplies the stem and gives import, export, transport and portable; the agent suffix is English, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 portare「搬运」提供词干，并衍生 import、export、transport 与 portable；施动后缀则来自英语，而非拉丁语。

items.example: They import fruit from the south.
The suffix turns actions into parties.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动作变成一方。
进口商办理了这批货的进境手续。
进口商们成立了一个行业协会。

items.meaning: allowed or able to be imported
items.example: The seed is no longer importable.

items.meaningCN: 把货物向外卖出的一方
items.exampleCN: 出口商发出了订单货物。

items.example: The porter moved the trunks upstairs.
A portable lamp lit the tent.
items.exampleCN: 一盏便携灯照亮了帐篷。

definition_zh: 出口；输出（货物、数据、观念）；（复数）出口货物；出口业务
definition_en: to send goods, data or ideas out to another country or system; also the goods so sent
core_image: 码头吊机把贴着本国标签的箱子从仓库吊上外轮，箱子越过防波堤驶向海平线
scene: 出口码头上，工人把一批本国制造的机械装上外轮，货物离开国境驶向海外买家。The manufacturer decided to export the machines to three overseas buyers.
sceneCN: 这里指「把本国货物运出去销售」，对应第 1 个义项：向境外买方出售并运出商品；句意为这家制造商决定把这批机械出口给三家海外买家。画面要点：码头吊机、本国标签、外轮船体、海平线。

pos.zh: 出口；输出（动词重音在后）
出口货物；出口（名词重音在前，常用复数 exports）

derivatives.zh: 出口商（export 加施动后缀，指向境外卖出货物的一方）
出口行为（export 加表示动作的后缀，指运出的过程）
出口的（export 加过去分词后缀作形容词，指已经运出的）
出口活动（export 加现在分词后缀作名词，指持续进行的出口）
可出口的（export 加表示可能的形容词后缀，指允许或能够外销）

senses.title: Sell goods to another country
senses.titleCN: 向另一国出售货物
senses.definition: to sell and send goods to buyers in another country
senses.definitionCN: 把货物卖给另一国的买方并运出
senses.example: The manufacturer decided to export the machines to three overseas buyers.
senses.exampleCN: 这家制造商决定把这批机械出口给三家海外买家。
senses.why: Latin exportare is ex- 'out' plus portare 'to carry', so the verb means to carry goods outward across a border.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 exportare 由 ex-「向外」加 portare「搬运」构成，动词意为把货物搬出边界。

senses.title: Send goods out of a country
senses.titleCN: 把货物运出国境
senses.definition: to send goods out of a country, including shipments made without a sale
senses.definitionCN: 把货物运出国境，也包括并非因买卖而发生的运出
senses.example: The charity exported medical supplies to the border region.
senses.exampleCN: 该慈善机构把医疗物资运往边境地区。
senses.why: Sale is the usual reason for the outward shipment, but the verb itself only records the direction.
senses.whyCN: 买卖通常是外运的原因，但动词本身只记录方向。

senses.title: Move data out of a program
senses.titleCN: 把数据从程序中导出
senses.definition: to save data from one application in a form another system can read
senses.definitionCN: 把某个应用中的数据保存成另一系统可读的形式
senses.example: Export the table as a text file before switching systems.
senses.exampleCN: 在切换系统之前先把表格导出为文本文件。
senses.why: Computing kept the customs image: the data crosses out of the program's boundary and must pass a format checkpoint.
senses.whyCN: 计算机沿用了海关的意象：数据跨出程序边界，还要经过格式这道关卡。

senses.title: Spread ideas or practices outward
senses.titleCN: 把观念或做法向外传播
senses.definition: to carry ideas, culture or practices from one place to others
senses.definitionCN: 把观念、文化或做法从一地传到别处
senses.example: The city exported its festival format to neighbouring towns.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市把自己的节庆形式传播到了邻近城镇。
senses.why: When the cargo is cultural, the same outward motion describes influence rather than trade.
senses.whyCN: 当货物是文化时，同一个向外动作描述的是影响力而不是贸易。

senses.title: Goods sold abroad
senses.titleCN: 销往境外的货物（复数名词）
senses.definition: goods sold to buyers in other countries, usually counted in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 卖给他国买方的货物，通常以复数计
senses.example: Exports of machinery reached a record high.
senses.exampleCN: 机械出口创下历史新高。
senses.why: As with import, English turns the action into a countable noun for the thing moved.
senses.whyCN: 与 import 一样，英语把动作转为可数名词，用来指被移动的东西。

senses.title: The business of exporting
senses.titleCN: 出口这一行业或活动
senses.definition: the trade or activity of selling goods abroad, considered as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 向境外销售货物的行业或活动，作为一个整体来看
senses.example: Export accounts for a third of the company's revenue.
senses.exampleCN: 出口占公司收入的三分之一。
senses.why: The uncountable use names the flow, which is why it appears in policy, taxation and accounts.
senses.whyCN: 不可数用法指这股流动，因此常见于政策、税收与账目语境。

senses.title: A commodity that a country sells abroad
senses.titleCN: 一国向境外售出的主要商品
senses.definition: a product that a country or region sells abroad, especially its leading earner
senses.definitionCN: 某国或地区向境外售出的产品，尤指其主要创汇商品
senses.example: Coffee is the country's main export.
senses.exampleCN: 咖啡是这个国家的主要出口商品。
senses.why: A single commodity can stand for the whole flow, so the countable noun came to name star products.
senses.whyCN: 单一商品可以代表整股流动，于是这个可数名词也用来指拳头产品。

senses.title: The exported file or dataset
senses.titleCN: 导出的文件或数据集
senses.definition: a file or set of records produced by exporting data from a system
senses.definitionCN: 从系统中导出数据后产生的文件或记录集
senses.example: The nightly export is stored on a separate drive.
senses.exampleCN: 每晚导出的文件存放在另一块磁盘上。
senses.why: Computing also names the product of the action, so the file itself becomes an export.
senses.whyCN: 计算机也为动作的产物命名，于是文件本身就成了一个 export。

intro.en: Export comes from Latin exportare 'to carry out', built on ex- 'out' and portare 'to carry'. The deeper source of portare is generally reconstructed. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: export 出自拉丁 exportare「搬出去」，由 ex-「向外」与 portare「搬运」构成；portare 的更深来源一般为重构形式。年代均为约数。

items.en: Portare 'to carry, convey' is the shared stem of a large family; its pre-Latin origin is reconstructed rather than recorded.
items.cn: portare「搬运、运送」是一大词族的共同词干；其拉丁语之前的来源属重构，而非有记录的形式。

items.en: Ex- 'out' plus portare gave exportare 'to carry out, send away', used of goods and of persons sent out of a place.
items.cn: ex-「向外」加 portare 构成 exportare「搬出、送走」，既用于货物，也用于被送出某地的人。

items.en: English borrowed the verb directly from Latin, at first in the general sense of sending something out.
items.cn: 英语直接从拉丁语借入这个动词，最初泛指把某物送出。

items.en: With the growth of overseas commerce, export fixed on selling goods to foreign buyers, and the noun followed.
items.cn: 随着海外商业扩张，export 固定为向外国买方销售货物，名词义随后出现。

items.en: Twentieth-century computing reused the outward movement for data leaving an application, and later for the file produced.
items.cn: 20 世纪的计算机把这一向外动作用于离开应用程序的数据，后来又用于产生的文件。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin carrying root or looks close to it; the second group contains other ways of saying that something is sent outward.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语「搬运」词根或与之外形相近；第二组是其他表示「向外送出」的说法。

entries.definition: In- 'into' plus portare: the mirror verb, carrying goods inward.
entries.definitionCN: in-「向内」加 portare：镜像动词，把货物搬进来。

entries.definition: The act or process of exporting; it names the procedure, not the goods or the person.
entries.definitionCN: 出口的行为或过程；它指程序，不指货物或人。

entries.definition: The party that exports; the verb plus the agent suffix names a firm rather than a flow.
entries.definitionCN: 从事出口的一方；动词加施动后缀，指公司而不是流动。

entries.definition: A harbour, from Latin portus 'harbour', not from portare 'carry'; the two look related but are separate words.
entries.definitionCN: 港口，出自拉丁 portus「港湾」，并非 portare「搬运」；两者形近却是不同的词。

entries.definition: To sell in a foreign market; it stresses the transaction, while export stresses the shipment outward.
entries.definitionCN: 在外国市场销售；它强调交易，而 export 强调向外运出。

entries.definition: To send goods by carrier; it covers the physical movement but not the customs status.
entries.definitionCN: 用承运人把货物送出；它覆盖实体位移，却不含海关身份。

entries.definition: The everyday phrase for sending something to another country, with no commercial implication.
entries.definitionCN: 把东西送到另一国的日常说法，不含商业含义。

entries.definition: To move something from one place or system to another; export always implies a national or system boundary.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物从一处或一个系统移到另一处；export 始终隐含国界或系统边界。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real outward prefix, the real carrying root and real trade phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的向外前缀、真实的搬运词根与真实贸易搭配。

normal.en: Ex- 'out' + portare 'carry': to carry outward.
normal.cn: ex-「向外」+ portare「搬运」：往外搬。

normal.en: The family runs export, exporter, exportation and exportable.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 export、exporter、exportation 与 exportable。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the trade sense: export market, export earnings, export licence.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出贸易义：出口市场、出口收入、出口许可证。

normal.en: The mirror word is import, the same root with the opposite prefix.
normal.cn: 镜像词是 import，同一词根配相反前缀。

normal.en: Stress shifts with word class: to exPORT is the act, an EXport is the cargo.
normal.cn: 重音随词类移动：动词是动作，名词是货物。

abstract.en: Picture a crate carried past a line in the sand, and the line is what makes it an export.
abstract.cn: 想象一只箱子被搬过沙地上的一条线，正是这条线让它成为出口货物。

abstract.en: Picture a song learned in one town and sung in the next, carrying its origin quietly.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌在一个镇学会、在下一个镇唱起，悄悄带着它的来处。

abstract.en: Picture a folder leaving one program's room and arriving in another's, repacked for the trip.
abstract.cn: 想象一个文件夹离开某个程序的房间，为旅途重新打包后进入另一个程序。

examples.en: The country exports cocoa to Europe and Asia.
examples.cn: 这个国家向欧洲和亚洲出口可可。

examples.en: Higher export earnings eased the pressure on the currency.
examples.cn: 出口收入增加缓解了货币压力。

examples.en: Export the contacts before you change phones.
examples.cn: 换手机之前先把联系人导出去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「往外搬」——ex 是向外，port 是搬，把本国货搬出国门 → 出口

root: 拉丁 exportare「搬出去」= ex-（向外）+ portare「搬运」；portare 更深来源为重构形式。与 import 共用词根，方向相反。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one outward motion. It starts at a customs line, widens to aid shipments, moves into software, spreads to culture, then settles into countable cargo, an industry, a star commodity and finally the exported file.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一个向外动作展开：从海关线开始，扩展到援助运输与软件导出，再延伸到文化传播，最后落在可数货物、整个行业、拳头商品，以及被导出的文件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crane lifting national crates over the breakwater onto a foreign ship.
core.cn: 核心意象：吊机把本国货箱越过防波堤吊上外轮。

branches.en: BASE MOTION: goods are sold and carried across a border.
branches.cn: 基础动作：货物被卖出并越过边界运走。

branches.en: DIRECTION WITHOUT SALE: aid and other shipments still leave the country.
branches.cn: 无买卖的方向：援助等运输同样离境。

branches.en: DATA OUTPUT: the boundary becomes a program's edge.
branches.cn: 数据输出：边界变成程序的边缘。

branches.en: CULTURAL OUTWARD: practices travel like cargo.
branches.cn: 文化外传：做法像货物一样出行。

branches.en: NAMED PRODUCTS: cargo, trade, a leading commodity and a saved file all take the noun.
branches.cn: 被命名的产物：货物、行业、拳头商品与保存的文件都用这个名词。

intro.en: Export is a Latin verb of direction, and both its prefix and its root build other English words.
intro.cn: export 是一个表示方向的拉丁动词，其前缀与词根都还构成其他英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin portare 'to carry' gives export, import, transport, portable and porter; ex- marks the direction outward.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 portare「搬运」衍生 export、import、transport、portable 与 porter；ex- 标出向外的方向。

items.example: The prefix turns carrying into sending out.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把「搬」变成「送出去」。

items.example: The root names the physical movement.
They export timber to two neighbours.
items.exampleCN: 他们向两个邻国出口木材。

items.meaning: goods sent out, or the act in the third person
items.meaningCN: 运出的货物，或第三人称的动作

items.meaning: a firm or person that exports
the act of sending goods out
items.example: Exportation of the grain was halted.

items.meaning: fit or allowed to be exported
items.exampleCN: 只有分级过的水果才能出口。

items.example: The radio is small and portable.

latinEntries.meaningCN: 港湾（与 portare 形近而不同源）

definition_zh: 出口商；出口国；报关出口方；导出程序或导出工具
definition_en: a person, firm or country that sells or sends goods out to another country
core_image: 码头尽头一位商人把提单递给船长，身后是已经装好的本国货物，船将驶向海外
scene: 出口码头上，一位商人把提单递给船长，身后的本国货物已经全部装船。The exporter handed over the bill of lading before the ship left for overseas buyers.
sceneCN: 这里指「把货物卖到境外的出口商」，对应第 1 个义项：向另一国买方售出并运出货物的一方；句意为这位出口商在船离港前把提单交给船长。画面要点：码头、提单、已装船的本国货物、远处的船身。

pos.zh: 出口商；出口方（可数，指公司、个人或国家）

derivatives.zh: 出口（exporter 的基础动词，去掉施动后缀即得，指把货物搬出去）
出口行为（export 加表示动作的名词后缀，指过程而非人）
可出口的（export 加表示可能的形容词后缀，指允许或能够外销）
多个出口方（exporter 加复数后缀，语义由单方转为多方）
报关出口方（exporter 加 of record 构成的法定称谓，指登记在案的出口责任方）

senses.title: A firm that sells goods abroad
senses.titleCN: 把货物卖到境外的公司
senses.definition: a business that sells and ships its goods to buyers in other countries
senses.definitionCN: 把货物卖给另一国买方并运出的企业
senses.example: The exporter handed over the bill of lading before the ship left for overseas buyers.
senses.exampleCN: 这位出口商在船离港前把提单交给船长。
senses.why: Export is the act of carrying goods out, and the agent suffix names the party performing it, so exporter is 'the one who sends out'.
senses.whyCN: export 是把货物搬出去的动作，施动后缀指执行者，因此 exporter 就是「把货送出去的那一个」。

senses.title: A country that sells more than it buys
senses.titleCN: 出口大于进口的国家或地区
senses.definition: a country or region whose sales abroad exceed its purchases from abroad
senses.definitionCN: 向外售出多于从境外购入的国家或地区
senses.example: The country is a net exporter of copper and a net importer of wheat.
senses.exampleCN: 该国是铜的净出口方、小麦的净进口方。
senses.why: Trade balances are counted at the level of economies, so a whole country can be called a party that exports.
senses.whyCN: 贸易差额在经济体层面计算，于是整个国家也能被称作出口的一方。

senses.title: The party legally responsible at customs
senses.titleCN: 在海关承担法律责任的报关出口方
senses.definition: the party registered as legally responsible for goods leaving the country
senses.definitionCN: 在货物出境时被登记为承担法律责任的一方
senses.example: The exporter of record filed the declaration before loading.
senses.exampleCN: 报关出口方在装船前提交了申报。
senses.why: Each shipment needs one accountable name, so the commercial role hardened into a customs status.
senses.whyCN: 每票货物都需要一个可追责的名字，商业角色于是固化为海关身份。

senses.title: A seller of power or fuel to another grid
senses.titleCN: 向其他电网或市场售电、售燃料的一方
senses.definition: a utility, region or country that sells electricity or fuel beyond its own system
senses.definitionCN: 向本系统之外售出电力或燃料的公用事业、地区或国家
senses.example: The province became a net exporter of electricity after the dams were built.
senses.exampleCN: 水坝建成后，该省成为电力净出口方。
senses.why: Energy flows across grid boundaries like cargo across borders, and the sending side takes the same label.
senses.whyCN: 能源像货物过境一样跨过电网边界，送出的一端得到同样的称呼。

senses.title: A tool that writes data out
senses.titleCN: 把数据写出去的导出程序
senses.definition: a routine or feature that saves data from an application in an outside format
senses.definitionCN: 把应用中的数据保存成外部格式的程序或功能
senses.example: The exporter writes the results to a plain text file.
senses.exampleCN: 导出程序把结果写进一个纯文本文件。
senses.why: Software names the routine as if it were a party, so the tool that sends data out is an exporter.
senses.whyCN: 软件把这个程序当作一方来命名，于是把数据送出去的工具就叫 exporter。

senses.title: A body that spreads cultural practices
senses.titleCN: 向外传播文化做法的人或机构
senses.definition: a person or institution that carries its own practices or ideas to other places
senses.definitionCN: 把自身做法或观念带到别处的个人或机构
senses.example: The conservatory became an exporter of a distinctive teaching style.
senses.exampleCN: 这所音乐学院成了一种独特教学风格的传播者。
senses.why: The outward motion survives without money: influence, too, can be shipped.
senses.whyCN: 向外动作不需要金钱也能成立：影响力同样可以被「运出去」。

senses.title: A producer of one commodity for foreign sale
senses.titleCN: 为外销生产某一商品的生产方
senses.definition: a farm, mine or producer that supplies a single commodity to foreign markets
senses.definitionCN: 向外国市场供应单一商品的农场、矿山或生产者
senses.example: The region is the world's largest exporter of lentils.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区是世界上最大的扁豆出口方。
senses.why: Commodity chains need a named origin, so the producer at the head of the chain is called the exporter.
senses.whyCN: 商品链需要一个具名的源头，于是链条最前端的生产者被称为出口方。

senses.title: The selling side of a trade contract
senses.titleCN: 贸易合同中的卖方一方
senses.definition: the party in a sales contract that sells and delivers the goods
senses.definitionCN: 买卖合同中出售并交付货物的一方
senses.example: The exporter covers insurance under the agreed terms.
senses.exampleCN: 按约定条款，出口方负责投保。
senses.why: Contracts prefer role names, so exporter serves as shorthand for the seller who ships.
senses.whyCN: 合同偏好角色名称，因此 exporter 成为「负责发运的卖方」的简称。

intro.en: Exporter is export plus the English agent suffix -er, so it names the doer of an outward carrying. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: exporter 是 export 加英语施动后缀 -er 构成，为「向外搬运」这一动作的执行者命名。年代均为约数。

items.en: Exportare 'to carry out' supplied the verb, built on ex- 'out' and portare 'to carry'.
items.cn: exportare「搬出去」提供动词，由 ex-「向外」与 portare「搬运」构成。

items.en: The suffix -er descends from Old English -ere and is the native means of naming a doer.
items.cn: 后缀 -er 源自古英语 -ere，是英语本族为执行者命名的手段。

items.en: As export settled into trade, exporter named the merchant who sold and shipped to foreign buyers.
items.cn: 随着 export 在贸易中固定下来，exporter 指向外国买方销售并发运的商人。

items.en: Customs law created the party of record, while trade statistics applied the word to whole economies.
items.cn: 海关法确立登记方，贸易统计则把这个词用到整个经济体上。

items.en: Software later borrowed the word for routines that write data out of an application.
items.cn: 软件随后借用这个词，指把数据写出应用程序的程序。

note.en: The first group shares the outward carrying stem or looks close to it; the second group names parties that also sell or ship.
note.cn: 第一组共享「向外搬运」词干或与之外形相近；第二组是同样销售或发运的一方。

entries.definition: The act of sending goods out; only the suffix turns it into a party.
entries.definitionCN: 把货物送出的动作；只有加上后缀才成为一方。

entries.definition: The procedure of exporting; it names the flow, while exporter names who causes it.
entries.definitionCN: 出口的程序；它指流动，而 exporter 指促成流动的人。

entries.definition: The same suffix on the opposite prefix: the party that buys and receives from abroad.
entries.definitionCN: 同一后缀加相反前缀：从境外买入并接收货物的一方。

entries.definition: A harbour, from Latin portus, not from portare; an exporter may use a port, but the words are unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 港口，出自拉丁 portus，并非 portare；出口商可能用港口，但两个词并无同源关系。

entries.definition: Anyone who sells; exporter adds that the buyer is abroad and the goods must leave the country.
entries.definitionCN: 任何卖方；exporter 额外说明买方在境外、货物必须离境。

entries.definition: A firm that provides goods to buyers; it may sell at home, while an exporter sells across a border.
entries.definitionCN: 向买方提供货物的公司；它可以在国内销售，而出口商跨越国界销售。

entries.definition: The party that arranges or performs the carriage; an exporter may also be the shipper, but the roles are distinct.
entries.definitionCN: 安排或执行运输的一方；出口商可能同时是发货人，但两个角色不同。

entries.definition: The selling party in a transaction or contract; exporter is the trade-specific narrowing of that role.
entries.definitionCN: 交易或合同中的卖方；exporter 是这一角色在贸易中的具体化。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real verb, the real suffix and real trade roles.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的动词、真实的后缀与真实贸易角色。

normal.en: Export plus -er: the party that carries goods out.
normal.cn: export 加 -er：把货物搬出去的那一方。

normal.en: The suffix marks a doer, so exporter can sign, invoice and be audited.
normal.cn: 后缀标出执行者，因此出口商能签字、开票、被审计。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the roles: net exporter, major exporter, exporter of record.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出角色：净出口方、主要出口商、报关出口方。

normal.en: The counterpart is importer, the same suffix on the opposite prefix.
normal.cn: 对应词是 importer，同一后缀加在相反的前缀上。

normal.en: An exporter sells outward; the goods, not the money, does the travelling.
normal.cn: 出口商向外销售；出行的是货物，不是钱。

abstract.en: Picture one signature at the end of a pier that sends a whole shipment on its way.
abstract.cn: 想象码头尽头一个签名，就把整票货物送上了路。

abstract.en: Picture a country drawn as a seller standing at the border with a full cart.
abstract.cn: 想象一个国家被画成站在边境、推着满车货物的卖方。

abstract.en: Picture a program packing its records into a box and pushing it out the door.
abstract.cn: 想象一个程序把记录装进箱子，推出门外。

examples.en: The exporter shipped the order two weeks ahead of schedule.
examples.cn: 出口商比计划提前两周发出了订单。

examples.en: Brazil is a major exporter of soybeans.
examples.cn: 巴西是大豆的主要出口国。

examples.en: The exporter of record must retain the shipping documents.
examples.cn: 报关出口方必须保存运输单据。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「往外搬的人」——export 是搬出去，加个表示人的尾巴，就是负责卖到境外的那一方 → 出口商

root: export「出口」+ -er（英语本族施动后缀，源自古英语 -ere），指执行出口的人、公司或国家；同根动词出自拉丁 exportare。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all name a party: a trading firm, a national economy, a customs debtor, an energy seller, a software routine, a cultural carrier, a commodity producer and the selling side of a contract.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项指的都是某一方：贸易公司、国家经济、海关义务人、能源卖方、软件程序、文化传播者、商品生产者，以及合同中的卖方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one merchant at a pier handing a bill of lading to a captain.
core.cn: 核心意象：码头边一位商人把提单递给船长。

branches.en: BASE DOER: the suffix turns carrying out into a business role.
branches.cn: 基础施动者：后缀把「搬出去」变成商业角色。

branches.en: WHOLE ECONOMIES: a country or grid acts as one seller.
branches.cn: 整体经济：国家或电网被当作单一卖方。

branches.en: LEGAL PARTY: customs and contracts need one named seller to carry liability.
branches.cn: 法律一方：海关与合同都需要一个具名卖方来承担责任。

branches.en: SYSTEM OUTPUT: software names its writing routine as a doer.
branches.cn: 系统出口：软件把写数据的程序也称作施动者。

branches.en: BEYOND GOODS: ideas and single commodities are sent out by the same kind of party.
branches.cn: 货物之外：观念与单一商品也由同类一方送出。

intro.en: Exporter combines a Latin verb of outward carrying with the native English suffix for doers.
intro.cn: exporter 把拉丁语表示向外搬运的动词，与英语本族的施动后缀组合起来。

latinIntro.en: Latin portare 'to carry' supplies the stem and gives export, import, transport and portable; the agent suffix is English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 portare「搬运」提供词干，并衍生 export、import、transport 与 portable；施动后缀则来自英语。

items.example: They export wool to two markets.
items.exampleCN: 他们把羊毛出口到两个市场。

items.example: The suffix turns actions into parties.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动作变成一方。
出口商们抗议这项新税。

items.meaning: allowed or able to be exported
items.example: The fruit is exportable after inspection.

items.exampleCN: 进口商办理了货物进境手续。

definition_zh: 出口；输出；（货物的）外运；（历史上的）遣送出境外
definition_en: the act or process of sending goods, data or people out of a country
core_image: 海关档案室里一本厚厚的簿册，每一页都记着一批离境货物的名称、数量与去向
scene: 海关档案室里，关员把一批刚离境的货物逐项登记到簿册上，记录它们的数量与去向。The clerk recorded the exportation of the machinery in a thick ledger.
sceneCN: 这里指「货物外运这一行为」，对应第 1 个义项：把货物从本国送出境的动作与过程；句意为关员把这批机械的出口登记进一本厚簿册。画面要点：档案室、厚簿册、离境货物清单、登记笔。

pos.zh: 出口；输出（不可数，指行为或过程）

forms.label: 复数（少见，指多次外运事件）

derivatives.zh: 出口（exportation 的基础动词，去掉行动名词后缀即得，指把货物搬出去）
出口商（export 加施动后缀，指执行外运的一方）
可出口的（export 加表示可能的形容词后缀，指允许外销）
多次外运（exportation 加复数后缀，语义由单次过程转为多次事件）
出口带动的（export 加 led 构成的复合形容词，指增长由出口驱动）

senses.title: The act of sending goods out of a country
senses.titleCN: 把货物送出国境的行为
senses.definition: the act or process of sending goods out of a country to another market
senses.definitionCN: 把货物从本国送出、运往另一市场的动作或过程
senses.example: The clerk recorded the exportation of the machinery in a thick ledger.
senses.exampleCN: 关员把这批机械的出口登记进一本厚簿册。
senses.why: Latin exportatio is a noun of action from exportare 'to carry out', so the word names the carrying itself rather than the cargo or the carrier.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 exportatio 是由 exportare「搬出去」构成的行动名词，因此这个词指搬运本身，而不是货物或承运人。

senses.title: The customs procedure for goods leaving
senses.titleCN: 货物离境的海关手续
senses.definition: the official procedure, declaration and permission required for goods to leave a country
senses.definitionCN: 货物离境所需的官方手续、申报与许可
senses.example: Exportation requires a declaration filed before loading.
senses.exampleCN: 出口须在装船前提交申报。
senses.why: Once a state watches goods leave, the act acquires paperwork, and the noun shifts from motion to procedure.
senses.whyCN: 一旦国家要看着货物离开，这个动作就有了文书，名词便从位移转向程序。

senses.title: The measured outflow in trade statistics
senses.titleCN: 贸易统计中计量的外流量
senses.definition: the total quantity or value of goods sent out, as recorded in trade accounts
senses.definitionCN: 贸易账目中记录的送出货物总量或总值
senses.example: Exportation rose by nine percent in the second quarter.
senses.exampleCN: 第二季度出口量上升了百分之九。
senses.why: Statistics turn a repeated action into an aggregate, so the noun comes to denote a figure rather than an event.
senses.whyCN: 统计把反复发生的动作汇成总量，于是这个名词指一个数字而不是一次事件。

senses.title: A consignment sent abroad
senses.titleCN: 发往境外的一批货物
senses.definition: a particular shipment of goods sent out of the country
senses.definitionCN: 被送出本国的一批具体货物
senses.example: The exportation left the port on Tuesday.
senses.exampleCN: 这批出口货物周二离港。
senses.why: A process noun can also stand for its product, especially when the shipment is treated as one event.
senses.whyCN: 过程名词也能指它的产物，尤其当一批货物被视作一次事件时。

senses.title: Bulk sending of a single commodity
senses.titleCN: 单一商品的大宗外运
senses.definition: the large-scale sending of one commodity, such as grain or timber, to foreign buyers
senses.definitionCN: 把粮食、木材等单一商品大规模送往外国买方
senses.example: The exportation of grain was halted during the drought.
senses.exampleCN: 旱灾期间谷物外运被叫停。
senses.why: Commodity policy speaks of flows rather than shipments, so the abstract noun fits bans and quotas.
senses.whyCN: 商品政策谈的是流量而不是单票货物，因此抽象名词适合与禁令、配额搭配。

senses.title: The outward transfer of data
senses.titleCN: 数据向外转移
senses.definition: the transfer of data from one system to another, especially out of a controlled environment
senses.definitionCN: 数据从一个系统转移到另一个系统，尤指离开受控环境
senses.example: Cross-border data exportation is limited by the new rules.
senses.exampleCN: 新规限制了数据跨境输出。
senses.why: Computing and law borrowed the trade term because data, like cargo, can be moved out of a jurisdiction.
senses.whyCN: 计算机与法律借用贸易术语，因为数据和货物一样可以被移出管辖范围。

senses.title: Historical sending of people out of a country
senses.titleCN: 历史上把人员遣送出境外
senses.definition: the former practice of sending convicted persons or unwanted groups out of a country
senses.definitionCN: 旧时把罪犯或被视为多余的人群送出本国的做法
senses.example: The old records list the exportation of convicts to the colonies.
senses.exampleCN: 旧档案记载了把罪犯遣送到殖民地的做法。
senses.why: The verb once applied to persons as well as goods, so the noun retains this historical, now archaic sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词旧时也用于人，不只是货物，因此名词保留了这一历史义，如今已属古旧用法。

senses.title: The outward spread of ideas or culture
senses.titleCN: 观念或文化的外传
senses.definition: the carrying of ideas, styles or institutions from one country to others
senses.definitionCN: 把观念、风格或制度从一国传到别国
senses.example: The exportation of the city's design style changed neighbouring ports.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市设计风格的外传改变了邻近港口。
senses.why: The formal noun extends the trade image to influence, where nothing is bought and nothing is weighed.
senses.whyCN: 这一正式名词把贸易意象扩展到影响力，那里既无人购买，也无人称重。

intro.en: Exportation comes from Latin exportatio 'a carrying out', the action noun of exportare. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: exportation 出自拉丁 exportatio「搬出」，是 exportare 的行动名词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Portare 'to carry' formed the stem of the family, with a pre-Latin origin that is reconstructed rather than attested.
items.cn: portare「搬运」构成这个词族的词干，其拉丁语之前的来源属重构，而非有书证的形式。

items.en: Ex- 'out' plus portare gave exportare 'to carry out, send away'.
items.cn: ex-「向外」加 portare 构成 exportare「搬出、送走」。

items.en: The suffix -atio made a noun of action, so exportatio meant the carrying out itself.
items.cn: 后缀 -atio 构成行动名词，因此 exportatio 指「搬出」这一动作本身。

items.en: English took both the verb and the action noun from Latin, using them first in a general sense of sending out.
items.cn: 英语从拉丁语同时借入动词与行动名词，最初泛指「送出」。

items.en: Commercial and customs usage narrowed the noun to goods leaving a country, and later acts extended it to people and to data.
items.cn: 商业与海关用法把这个名词收窄为货物离境，后来的法令又把它扩展到人与数据。

note.en: The first group shares the outward carrying stem or looks close to it; the second group names related processes of sending things out.
note.cn: 第一组共享「向外搬运」词干或与之外形相近；第二组是其他表示「把东西送出去」的过程。

entries.definition: The act in verb form, or the goods themselves; exportation is the formal process noun with no plural cargo sense in ordinary use.
entries.definitionCN: 动词形式或指货物本身；exportation 是正式的过程名词，日常不指具体货物。

entries.definition: The party that exports; the two words differ in that one names a process and the other a person or firm.
entries.definitionCN: 执行出口的一方；两词的区别在于一个指过程，一个指人或公司。

entries.definition: The same action noun with the inward prefix: the process of bringing goods in.
entries.definitionCN: 同一行动名词配向内的前缀：把货物运入的过程。

entries.definition: Trans- 'across' plus portare: the process of carrying from place to place, with no border and no sale.
entries.definitionCN: trans-「穿过」加 portare：把货物从一处运到另一处的过程，不含国界与买卖。

entries.definition: A batch of goods sent by a carrier; it counts consignments, while exportation names the whole process.
entries.definitionCN: 承运人运送的一批货物；它计批次，而 exportation 指整个过程。

entries.definition: The movement of goods or money out of a place; it is neutral about borders and law.
entries.definitionCN: 货物或资金从一个地方流出的移动；对边界与法律保持中性。

entries.definition: A sale made in a foreign market; the money changes hands, while exportation records the goods leaving.
entries.definitionCN: 在外国市场完成的销售；钱在那里易手，而 exportation 记录的是货物离境。

entries.definition: The sending off of goods or messages; it stresses promptness rather than customs status.
entries.definitionCN: 把货物或消息送出；它强调迅速，而不是海关身份。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin action suffix, the real carrying root and real administrative phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁行动后缀、真实的搬运词根与真实行政搭配。

normal.en: -atio makes an action noun, so exportation is the carrying-out itself, not the cargo.
normal.cn: -atio 构成行动名词，所以 exportation 是「搬出」这个动作，而不是货物。

normal.en: The base verb is export, and the doer is exporter; the three form a set.
normal.cn: 基础动词是 export，执行者是 exporter，三者构成一套。

normal.en: Fixed phrases are administrative: exportation licence, ban on exportation, exportation records.
normal.cn: 固定搭配属行政语域：出口许可、出口禁令、出口记录。

normal.en: The mirror noun is importation, the same suffix with the inward prefix.
normal.cn: 镜像名词是 importation，同一后缀配向内的前缀。

normal.en: This noun is formal and uncountable in ordinary use, so it suits laws and reports.
normal.cn: 这个名词在通常用法中正式且不可数，因此适合法律与报告。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger where each line is an act, not a thing, and the act fills a page.
abstract.cn: 想象一本账簿，每一行是一个动作而不是一件东西，而这个动作占满一页。

abstract.en: Picture a border official stamping the leaving itself rather than the box.
abstract.cn: 想象边境官员盖章的对象是「离开」这件事，而不是箱子。

abstract.en: Picture a signal leaving a sealed room, its path written down before it goes.
abstract.cn: 想象一个信号离开封闭的房间，在出发前就先把路径记录下来。

examples.en: Exportation of the antique furniture was forbidden.
examples.cn: 这件古董家具被禁止出口。

examples.en: The report traced the exportation of raw cotton over ten years.
examples.cn: 报告追溯了十年间原棉的外运情况。

examples.en: New rules govern the exportation of personal data.
examples.cn: 新规管束个人数据的输出。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「往外搬这件事」——export 是搬出去，加上表示行为的尾巴，指搬出去的过程 → 出口、外运

root: 拉丁 exportare「搬出去」+ -atio（行动名词后缀）→ exportatio「搬出」；词根 portare 意为「搬运」，更深来源为重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all name a process or its record: the act of sending out, the customs procedure, the statistical flow, one consignment, a bulk commodity flow, a data transfer, a historical removal of people and a cultural spread.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都指一个过程或其记录：送出的动作、海关手续、统计流量、单批货物、大宗商品外运、数据转移、历史上的人员遣送，以及文化外传。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a customs ledger in which each leaving shipment occupies one line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本海关簿册，每一批离境货物占一行。

branches.en: BASE PROCESS: the noun names the carrying out itself.
branches.cn: 基础过程：名词指搬运出去这一动作本身。

branches.en: ADMINISTERED FLOW: paperwork and commodity policy turn the act into a regulated procedure.
branches.cn: 被管理的外流：文书与商品政策把动作变成受规管的程序。

branches.en: COUNTED AND BATCHED: the process becomes a figure, or one shipment.
branches.cn: 计量与分批：过程变成一个数字，或一批货物。

branches.en: DATA OUT: the same process applied to records leaving a system.
branches.cn: 数据外出：同一过程用于离开系统的记录。

branches.en: PEOPLE AND CULTURE: persons and ideas also travel under this name.
branches.cn: 人与文化：人与观念也以这个名义出行。

intro.en: Exportation is a Latin action noun: a prefix of direction, a verb of carrying and a suffix that turns the act into a noun.
intro.cn: exportation 是一个拉丁行动名词：方向前缀、搬运动词，以及把动作变为名词的后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin portare 'to carry' gives export, import, transport and portable, while -atio forms nouns of action such as exportatio and importatio.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 portare「搬运」衍生 export、import、transport 与 portable，-atio 则构成 exportatio、importatio 这类行动名词。

items.example: The prefix sets the direction of the carrying.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀决定搬运的方向。

items.example: The root names the movement of a load.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指一担货物的移动。

items.meaning: the act or result of doing
items.example: The suffix turns verbs into processes.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动词变成过程名词。

items.example: Exportation of the ore was recorded.

items.exampleCN: 他们每年冬天出口柑橘。

items.example: Importation of the seed is banned.

definition_zh: 全球市场；世界市场；某一产品的全球需求与交易体系
definition_en: the worldwide system in which goods, services and capital are bought and sold across national borders
core_image: 一颗地球仪上密布着连线，每一条线两端各是一处港口或交易所，货物与资金沿线来回
scene: 跨国公司的会议室里，墙上挂着一幅世界地图，负责人指着几处港口说，产品要在所有国家同时销售。The directors studied how the product would compete in the global market.
sceneCN: 这里指「全球范围的市场体系」，对应第 1 个义项：跨越各国边界的买卖与竞争场所；句意为董事们研究该产品将如何在全球市场中竞争。画面要点：世界地图、港口标记、会议桌、销售图表。

pos.zh: 全球市场；世界市场（可数，常用单数指整体体系，复数指多个区域市场）

collocations.phrase: a player in the global market

derivatives.zh: 使全球化（global 加动词后缀，语义从「整体」转为「扩展到全球」）
全球化（globalize 加名词后缀，指跨国整合的过程）
在全球范围内（global 加副词后缀，指作用范围）
市场场所（market 加 place 构成的复合词，指交易发生的具体场所）
营销（market 加动名词后缀，语义从「市场」转为「开拓市场的行为」）

senses.title: The worldwide trading arena
senses.titleCN: 世界范围的交易场所
senses.definition: the worldwide system in which goods, services and capital are exchanged across borders
senses.definitionCN: 货物、服务与资本跨国交换的世界性体系
senses.example: The directors studied how the product would compete in the global market.
senses.exampleCN: 董事们研究该产品将如何在全球市场上竞争。
senses.why: Global extends Latin globus 'sphere' to the whole earth, and market names a place of trade, so the phrase is the trading place of the whole sphere.
senses.whyCN: global 把拉丁 globus「球体」扩展到整个地球，market 指交易之所，合起来就是整个球面上的交易场所。

senses.title: Combined demand from all countries
senses.titleCN: 所有国家买方的合计需求
senses.definition: the total demand for a category of goods from buyers in every country
senses.definitionCN: 各国买方对某一类货物的需求总和
senses.example: Demand for the device grew across the global market.
senses.exampleCN: 全球市场对该设备的需求增长了。
senses.why: A market can mean the buyers themselves, so a global market is the sum of buyers everywhere rather than a physical place.
senses.whyCN: 市场也可以指买方本身，因此全球市场就是各地买方的总和，而不是一个实体场所。

senses.title: The worldwide market for one product
senses.titleCN: 某一产品的全球市场
senses.definition: the worldwide supply and demand for a single product or service
senses.definitionCN: 单一产品或服务在世界范围内的供给与需求
senses.example: The global market for memory chips is highly concentrated.
senses.exampleCN: 存储芯片的全球市场高度集中。
senses.why: Naming the product narrows the sphere to one trade, as in the steel market or the car market.
senses.whyCN: 点明产品就把整个球面收窄到一桩生意，如钢铁市场或汽车市场。

senses.title: The international capital market
senses.titleCN: 国际资本与金融市场
senses.definition: the cross-border system in which money, securities and credit are traded
senses.definitionCN: 资金、证券与信贷跨境交易的世界性体系
senses.example: Pension funds move capital through the global market every day.
senses.exampleCN: 养老基金每天都在全球市场中调度资本。
senses.why: Finance uses the same arena image, but the cargo is money and the ports are exchanges.
senses.whyCN: 金融沿用同一个场所意象，只是货物变成金钱，港口变成交易所。

senses.title: Access to customers outside one's country
senses.titleCN: 进入本国之外客户群的通道
senses.definition: the opportunity for a firm to sell to customers in other countries
senses.definitionCN: 企业向他国客户销售的机会
senses.example: Small firms struggle to reach the global market without partners.
senses.exampleCN: 小企业若没有伙伴，很难进入全球市场。
senses.why: From a company's viewpoint the phrase names an opening rather than a place, and entry becomes the key verb.
senses.whyCN: 从企业视角看，这个短语指一扇打开的门而不是一个地点，因此「进入」成了常用动词。

senses.title: Worldwide competitive position
senses.titleCN: 全球范围的竞争地位
senses.definition: the rank or share that a firm holds in worldwide sales of a product
senses.definitionCN: 企业在某产品的世界销售额中所占的排名或份额
senses.example: The company holds a third of the global market in turbines.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司占全球涡轮机市场的三分之一。
senses.why: Share language turns the arena into a pie to be divided, so the phrase measures position rather than describes trade.
senses.whyCN: 份额的说法把竞技场变成一块待分的饼，于是这个短语衡量的是地位，而不是描述贸易。

senses.title: The price level set worldwide
senses.titleCN: 由全球供求形成的价格水平
senses.definition: the price of a commodity determined by worldwide supply and demand rather than local conditions
senses.definitionCN: 由世界范围供求而非本地情况决定的商品价格
senses.example: Wheat prices now follow the global market, not the village harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 小麦价格如今跟着全球市场走，而不是看村里收成。
senses.why: When buyers and sellers are everywhere, no single locality sets the price, so the phrase denotes a price formed collectively.
senses.whyCN: 当买卖双方遍布各地，任何单一场地都无法定价，因此这个短语指集体形成的价格。

senses.title: Worldwide competition as an arena
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：把全球竞争视作一个竞技场
senses.definition: the abstract arena in which firms, cities or ideas compete for worldwide attention and sales
senses.definitionCN: 企业、城市或观念争夺全球关注与销售份额的抽象竞技场
senses.example: Universities now compete in a global market for students.
senses.exampleCN: 大学如今在学生这一全球市场中相互竞争。
senses.why: The metaphor widens once more: anything that can attract people or money can be said to have a global market.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻再度扩展：凡能吸引人或钱的东西，都可以说拥有一个全球市场。

intro.en: Global market joins two separate Latin lines: global from globus 'sphere', market from mercatus 'trade'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: global market 联结了两条独立的拉丁语线索：global 出自 globus「球体」，market 出自 mercatus「交易」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Globus meant a ball or sphere, and it was used for the round earth by Roman writers.
items.cn: globus 意为球或球体，罗马作家也用它指圆形的大地。

items.en: French formed global in the sense of taking the whole into one view, and English adopted it in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 法语构成 global，意为把整体纳入一个视野；英语在 17 世纪吸收了它。

items.en: Mercatus meant trade or a marketplace, from mercari 'to trade' and merx 'merchandise'.
items.cn: mercatus 意为交易或市场，出自 mercari「做买卖」与 merx「货物」。

items.en: Old English borrowed market through Latin and French, first as a place and then as the demand found there.
items.cn: 古英语经拉丁语与法语借入 market，最初指地点，随后指那里出现的需求。

items.en: Global market became common in the late twentieth century as transport and finance knit national markets together.
items.cn: 20 世纪后期，随着运输与金融把各国市场织在一起，global market 成为常用说法。

note.en: The first group shares one of the two roots and looks close; the second group names markets that differ by scope.
note.cn: 第一组共享两个词根之一且外形相近；第二组是按范围区分的不同市场。

entries.definition: A sphere or a model of the earth; it is the object from which the adjective global was made, not a trading place.
entries.definitionCN: 球体或地球模型；它是 global 这个形容词的来源物，不是交易场所。

entries.definition: The process of knitting economies and cultures together; a global market is one result of that process, not the process itself.
entries.definitionCN: 把经济与文化织在一起的过程；全球市场是该过程的一个结果，而不是过程本身。

entries.definition: A concrete place or platform where buying and selling happen; global market stresses scope rather than location.
entries.definitionCN: 买卖发生的具体地点或平台；global market 强调的是范围而不是位置。

entries.definition: A trading place, shortened from market but influenced by Dutch; it names a local venue, not a worldwide system.
entries.definitionCN: 交易场所，由 market 缩略并受荷兰语影响；它指本地场地，而非世界体系。

entries.definition: Nearly interchangeable with global market; world is native English and global is the Latin-derived formal variant.
entries.definitionCN: 与 global market 几乎可互换；world 是英语本族词，global 是拉丁来源的正式变体。

entries.definition: Trade between countries; it stresses relations across borders, while global market stresses the whole as one arena.
entries.definitionCN: 国家之间的贸易；它强调跨国关系，而 global market 强调整体是一个竞技场。

entries.definition: Markets beyond the sea from the speaker's country; the phrase is relative to a home base, unlike global market.
entries.definitionCN: 从说话者本国看去的海外市场；这个说法相对于本国而言，而 global market 不带立场。

entries.definition: A group of countries treating their economies as one market, such as a customs union; it is regional, not worldwide.
entries.definitionCN: 把若干国家经济体当作一个市场的集团，如关税同盟；它是区域性的，不是全球的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the sphere root, the trade root and real market phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：球体词根、交易词根与真实市场搭配。

normal.en: Global is the whole sphere; market is where trade happens; the phrase is trade on the whole sphere.
normal.cn: global 是整个球面，market 是交易发生之处，短语就是整个球面上的交易。

normal.en: The two halves come from different Latin words: globus for the sphere, mercatus for trade.
normal.cn: 两半来自不同的拉丁词：globus 指球体，mercatus 指交易。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the uses: global market share, global market prices, enter the global market.
normal.cn: 固定搭配显示用法：全球市场份额、全球市场价格、进入全球市场。

normal.en: Global market is uncountable in its system sense and countable when it means several regional markets.
normal.cn: 指整个体系时不可数，指多个区域市场时可数。

normal.en: The phrase is about scope, so it pairs with verbs of reaching and competing, not with verbs of visiting.
normal.cn: 这个短语讲范围，因此常与「抵达」「竞争」类动词搭配，而不与「到访」类动词搭配。

abstract.en: Picture a globe wrapped in threads, each thread a trade route with a price tag at both ends.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗地球仪被线缠满，每根线是一条商路，两端各挂一个价签。

abstract.en: Picture one enormous auction hall with every country's flag on the wall and one running price board.
abstract.cn: 想象一座巨大的拍卖厅，墙上挂着各国旗帜，只有一块跳动的价目板。

abstract.en: Picture a stadium whose seats are filled by buyers from every continent, all watching the same scoreboard.
abstract.cn: 想象一座体育场，座位上坐满各洲来的买方，共同盯着同一块记分牌。

examples.en: The firm sells to the global market rather than to one region.
examples.cn: 这家公司面向全球市场销售，而不是只做一个区域。

examples.en: Cheap freight opened the global market to small producers.
examples.cn: 低廉的运费向小生产者打开了全球市场。

examples.en: Its global market share slipped as rivals expanded.
examples.cn: 随着对手扩张，它的全球市场份额下滑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「整个地球的集市」——球面全算进来，货物在各国之间买卖 → 全球市场

root: global 出自拉丁 globus「球体」，经法语 global 进入英语；market 出自拉丁 mercatus「交易」，源 merx「货物」。两者合成「覆盖整个地球的交易场」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe the same arena at different scales: the whole system, its combined demand, one product's worldwide trade, capital flows, a firm's access, its share, a world price and finally any competition for worldwide attention.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项描述同一竞技场的不同尺度：整个体系、其合计需求、单一产品的世界贸易、资本流动、企业的进入通道、企业份额、世界价格，最后是任何争夺全球关注的竞争。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a globe threaded with trade routes, each ending in a price.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗缠满商路的地球仪，每条路的尽头都标着价格。

branches.en: BASE ARENA: the trading place of the whole sphere.
branches.cn: 基础竞技场：整个球面的交易场所。

branches.en: DEMAND AND PRODUCT: the arena can be summed as buyers, or narrowed to one trade.
branches.cn: 需求与产品：这个竞技场可汇成买方总和，也可收窄到一桩生意。

branches.en: CAPITAL: the cargo becomes money and the ports become exchanges.
branches.cn: 资本：货物变成金钱，港口变成交易所。

branches.en: FIRM VIEW: the arena is an opening to be entered and a share to be held.
branches.cn: 企业视角：竞技场是一扇可进入的门，也是一份可持有的份额。

branches.en: PRICE AND METAPHOR: a world price forms, and any contest can be called a global market.
branches.cn: 价格与比喻：世界价格形成，任何争夺都可被称为全球市场。

intro.en: Global market is a phrase of two free words, each with a Latin root and a productive family.
intro.cn: global market 是由两个自由词构成的短语，各自有拉丁词根与能产的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin globus 'sphere' gives globe, global, globalization; Latin mercatus 'trade' gives market, marketing, marketplace and merchant.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 globus「球体」衍生 globe、global、globalization；拉丁 mercatus「交易」衍生 market、marketing、marketplace 与 merchant。

items.example: The element gives words about roundness and wholeness.
items.exampleCN: 这个成分构成一批关于圆形与整体的词。

items.example: The firm has a global network.
A globe stood in the library.
items.exampleCN: 图书馆里摆着一颗地球仪。
全球化把远方的工厂连在一起。

items.meaning: a place or system of trade

items.exampleCN: 线上交易平台发展很快。
一位商人在那里卖丝绸。

items.example: They compete in the global market.
items.exampleCN: 他们在全球市场上竞争。

latinEntries.structure: mercari, mercatus sum (verb, first conjugation, deponent)

definition_zh: 外国市场；境外市场；他国需求与交易环境
definition_en: a market in a country other than one's own, seen from the standpoint of a home-based seller
core_image: 一道海关线把地图分成两半，本国的工厂在线的这一侧，线的另一侧是挂着不同旗子的店铺
scene: 出口部门的会议上，经理摊开地图，指着海外的几座城市说下一年要先去那里试销。The team chose three foreign markets for the first year of sales.
sceneCN: 这里指「本国之外的市场」，对应第 1 个义项：相对于本国而言的其他国家市场；句意为团队选定了三个外国市场作为第一年的销售目标。画面要点：摊开的地图、海关线、不同旗帜的店铺标记。

pos.zh: 外国市场；境外市场（可数，复数 foreign markets）

derivatives.zh: 外国人（foreign 加表示人的后缀，语义从「境外的」转为「境外之人」）
陌生感；异域性（foreign 加名词后缀，指不属于本地的性质）
在国外出生的（foreign 加 born 构成的复合形容词）
市场；推销（短语的另一半，语义为交易场所或交易行为）
营销（market 加动名词后缀，语义从「市场」转为「开拓市场的工作」）

senses.title: A market outside one's own country
senses.titleCN: 本国之外的市场
senses.definition: a market located in another country, considered in contrast to the home market
senses.definitionCN: 位于另一国的市场，与本国市场相对而言
senses.example: The team chose three foreign markets for the first year of sales.
senses.exampleCN: 团队选定了三个外国市场作为第一年的销售目标。
senses.why: Foreign comes from Latin foris 'outside', so a foreign market is literally the market outside the gate of one's own country.
senses.whyCN: foreign 出自拉丁 foris「门外」，因此外国市场字面上就是本国大门之外的市场。

senses.title: The market of one specific country
senses.titleCN: 某一个具体国家的市场
senses.definition: the market of a named country, with its own buyers, rules and habits
senses.definitionCN: 某个具名国家的市场，有其自身的买方、规则与习惯
senses.example: The German foreign market proved harder to enter than expected.
senses.exampleCN: 德国这一外国市场比预想的更难进入。
senses.why: The phrase can be counted, so each national market becomes a separate foreign market with its own features.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语可以计数，于是每个国家市场都成为一个具有自身特点的外国市场。

senses.title: Foreign demand for a product
senses.titleCN: 境外对某产品的需求
senses.definition: the demand for a product that comes from buyers in other countries
senses.definitionCN: 来自他国买方对某产品的需求
senses.example: Foreign market demand for the vaccine outstripped supply.
senses.exampleCN: 境外市场对这种疫苗的需求超过了供给。
senses.why: Market also means the buyers themselves, so foreign market demand is demand located beyond the border.
senses.whyCN: market 也可指买方本身，因此境外市场需求就是位于边界之外的需求。

senses.title: The act of entering a foreign market
senses.titleCN: 进入外国市场这一动作
senses.definition: the process of establishing sales in a country other than one's own
