definition_zh: 保护主义；贸易保护主义；以关税和非关税手段庇护本国产业的主张
definition_en: the policy or doctrine of shielding domestic industries from foreign competition
core_image: 一道高墙围住本国的工厂，墙外货物排队等候，墙角写着按品类征税的价目
scene: 议会听证会上，一位议员主张给本国钢铁厂筑起关税高墙，以挡住海外低价货源。The senator defended protectionism as a way to keep local mills open.
sceneCN: 这里指「以壁垒庇护本国产业的主张」，对应第 1 个义项：通过关税与非关税手段限制外国竞争的政策；句意为这位参议员为保护主义辩护，称它能让本地工厂维持开工。画面要点：听证席、高墙、工厂烟囱、关税价目牌。

pos.zh: 保护主义；贸易保护主义（不可数）

derivatives.zh: 保护（protect 加名词后缀，指被遮蔽的状态或措施）
保护主义者；保护主义的（protectionism 的施动与形容形式）
保护性的（protect 加形容词后缀，指具有遮蔽作用的）
保护者（protect 加施动后缀，指执行保护的人或物）
保护（源自拉丁 protegere「在前面遮盖」，语义为挡住侵害）

senses.title: Shielding domestic industry by policy
senses.titleCN: 以政策庇护本国产业
senses.definition: the policy of restricting imports so that domestic producers face less foreign competition
senses.definitionCN: 限制进口以使本国生产者面对更少外国竞争的政策
senses.example: The senator defended protectionism as a way to keep local mills open.
senses.exampleCN: 这位参议员为保护主义辩护，称它能让本地工厂维持开工。
senses.why: Protection is a covering placed in front, and the suffix -ism turns it into a doctrine, so the word is a policy of standing a shield before home industry.
senses.whyCN: protection 是挡在前面的遮蔽物，后缀 -ism 把它变成一种主张，因此这个词就是用盾牌挡在本国产业之前的政策。

senses.title: Protection by tariffs
senses.titleCN: 以关税实现的保护
senses.definition: the use of import duties to make foreign goods more expensive than domestic ones
senses.definitionCN: 用进口税使外国货比本国货更贵
senses.example: Tariff protectionism raised the price of imported cloth.
senses.exampleCN: 关税保护主义抬高了进口布料的价格。
senses.why: A duty is the simplest wall, so the tariff case became the classic form of the doctrine.
senses.whyCN: 关税是最简单的墙，因此关税情形成为这种主张的经典形式。

senses.title: Protection by non-tariff means
senses.titleCN: 以非关税手段实现的保护
senses.definition: the use of quotas, licensing, standards or inspections to limit imports without a tariff
senses.definitionCN: 用配额、许可、标准或检验在不加关税的情况下限制进口
senses.example: Licensing rules became a quieter form of protectionism.
senses.exampleCN: 许可规则成了一种更安静的保护主义。
senses.why: When tariffs are capped by treaty, the same protective aim moves into paperwork and technical rules.
senses.whyCN: 当关税被条约封顶，同样的保护目的就转入文书与技术规则。

senses.title: Protection of a single sector
senses.titleCN: 针对某一行业的保护
senses.definition: protectionism applied to one industry, such as farming, steel or shipping
senses.definitionCN: 施加于某一行业（如农业、钢铁或航运）的保护主义
senses.example: Agricultural protectionism kept small farms alive but raised food prices.
senses.exampleCN: 农业保护主义让小块农场活了下来，却抬高了食品价格。
senses.why: Sector lobbies organize around one product, so the doctrine often appears with the industry's name attached.
senses.whyCN: 行业游说围绕单一产品组织起来，因此这种主张常附上行业名称。

senses.title: Protectionism as a political movement
senses.titleCN: 作为政治运动的保护主义
senses.definition: the organized political force that campaigns for barriers and against open trade
senses.definitionCN: 为壁垒奔走、反对开放贸易的有组织政治力量
senses.example: Protectionism gained seats in the election.
senses.exampleCN: 保护主义在选举中赢得了席位。
senses.why: A doctrine with supporters becomes a movement, and the word then names a camp rather than a measure.
senses.whyCN: 有支持者的主张会成为运动，于是这个词指一个阵营，而不是一项措施。

senses.title: New protectionism through technical rules
senses.titleCN: 借技术规则实现的新保护主义
senses.definition: the use of health, safety, environmental or technical standards as hidden barriers
senses.definitionCN: 把健康、安全、环境或技术标准当作隐蔽壁垒
senses.example: New protectionism hides inside product standards.
senses.exampleCN: 新保护主义藏在产品标准之中。
senses.why: Openly high tariffs invite retaliation, so protective intent disguises itself as legitimate regulation.
senses.whyCN: 公开的高关税会招致报复，因此保护意图伪装成正当监管。

senses.title: Protection in services and public contracts
senses.titleCN: 服务与公共采购领域的保护
senses.definition: the reservation of service markets or government contracts for domestic suppliers
senses.definitionCN: 把服务市场或政府采购留给本国供应商
senses.example: Protectionism in procurement shut foreign bidders out of the tender.
senses.exampleCN: 采购中的保护主义把外国投标者挡在招标之外。
senses.why: As goods barriers fall, the same shield moves to tenders, licences and professional qualifications.
senses.whyCN: 随着货物壁垒下降，同一面盾牌转向招标、许可与职业资格。

senses.title: The cost and retaliation of protection
senses.titleCN: 保护的代价与报复
senses.definition: the higher prices, retaliation and lost efficiency attributed to protective measures
senses.definitionCN: 归于保护措施的价格上升、报复与效率损失
senses.example: Economists warned that protectionism would invite counter-tariffs.
senses.exampleCN: 经济学家警告保护主义会招来反制关税。
senses.why: The word is usually used by critics, so it carries the claimed costs inside its meaning.
senses.whyCN: 这个词通常由批评者使用，因此它的词义里就带着所宣称的代价。

intro.en: Protectionism joins protection, from Latin protegere 'to cover in front', with -ism, a suffix for doctrines and systems. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: protectionism 把出自拉丁 protegere「在前面遮盖」的 protection，与表示主张与体系的后缀 -ism 组合起来。年代均为约数。

items.en: Tegere meant 'to cover', and it built words about roofs, clothing and concealment.
items.cn: tegere 意为「遮盖」，构成一批关于屋顶、衣物与掩蔽的词。

items.en: Pro- 'in front' plus tegere gave protegere 'to cover in front, defend', the source of protect.
items.cn: pro-「在前」加 tegere 构成 protegere「在前面遮盖、保卫」，是 protect 的来源。

items.en: English protection named the act of shielding, and by the eighteenth century also a policy of guarding trade.
items.cn: 英语 protection 指遮蔽的动作，到 18 世纪也指守护贸易的政策。

items.en: The suffix -ism came through French and Latin from Greek -ismos, and it names doctrines, systems and movements.
items.cn: 后缀 -ism 经法语与拉丁语来自希腊 -ismos，用来指学说、体系与运动。

items.en: Protectionism was coined in the free-trade debates of the nineteenth century as the label for the opposite camp.
items.cn: protectionism 在 19 世纪的自由贸易论战中被造出，用作对立阵营的标签。

note.en: The first group shares the covering root but has moved into other senses; the second group names policies and tools of the same family.
note.cn: 第一组共享「遮盖」词根但语义已转移；第二组是同一族系的政策与工具。

entries.definition: The act or state of being shielded; it can describe a helmet or a law, with no political camp attached.
entries.definitionCN: 被遮蔽的动作或状态；它可以描述头盔或法律，不带政治阵营色彩。

entries.definition: Serving to shield; it describes a quality or a measure, not a systematic policy.
entries.definitionCN: 起遮蔽作用的；它描述性质或措施，不是一套系统政策。

entries.definition: One who defends another; the word names an agent, not an economic doctrine.
entries.definitionCN: 保护他人的人；这个词指施动者，不是经济主张。

entries.definition: A supporter of protectionism, or an adjective describing such policies; the -ist form names the person, the -ism form names the doctrine.
entries.definitionCN: 保护主义的支持者，或描述这类政策的形容词；-ist 形式指人，-ism 形式指主张。

entries.definition: A duty on imports; it is the tool most often used by protectionism, but a single tariff is not a whole doctrine.
entries.definitionCN: 对进口征收的税；它是保护主义最常用的工具，但单项关税不是整套主张。

entries.definition: Any measure that obstructs imports or exports; protectionism is the policy of erecting such barriers.
entries.definitionCN: 任何阻碍进出口的措施；保护主义就是立起这类壁垒的政策。

entries.definition: The older doctrine that a state should maximize exports and treasure bullion; protectionism is its modern, narrower descendant.
entries.definitionCN: 较早的学说，主张国家应尽量扩大出口并珍视金银；保护主义是其现代、较窄的后裔。

entries.definition: A policy of staying out of foreign entanglements; it concerns diplomacy and war, not only trade.
entries.definitionCN: 避免卷入对外纠葛的政策；它关乎外交与战争，不只是贸易。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real covering root, the real doctrine suffix and real policy phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「遮盖」词根、真实的主张后缀与真实政策搭配。

normal.en: Protect is to cover in front; -ism makes it a doctrine, so the word is a policy of standing a shield before home industry.
normal.cn: protect 是在前面遮盖；-ism 使之成为主张，因此这个词就是把盾牌挡在本国产业前的政策。

normal.en: The family runs protect, protection, protective, protector and protectionist.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 protect、protection、protective、protector 与 protectionist。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the uses: trade protectionism, rising protectionism, a wave of protectionism.
normal.cn: 固定搭配显示用法：贸易保护主义、抬头的保护主义、保护主义浪潮。

normal.en: The standard opposite is free trade, and the two are usually defined against each other.
normal.cn: 标准反义说法是自由贸易，两者通常互为定义。

normal.en: The word is mostly used by critics, so it carries an implied judgment.
normal.cn: 这个词多由批评者使用，因此带有隐含的评判。

abstract.en: Picture a wall built around a factory while ships wait outside with their cargo unloaded.
abstract.cn: 想象一道墙把工厂围住，船在墙外等待，货物无法卸下。

abstract.en: Picture a tariff schedule posted like a menu at a border window.
abstract.cn: 想象一份关税表像菜单一样贴在边境窗口。

abstract.en: Picture a rulebook of standards so thick that only local producers know how to pass it.
abstract.cn: 想象一本标准规则书厚到只有本地生产者知道怎么通过。

examples.en: Rising protectionism slowed the growth of world trade.
examples.cn: 保护主义抬头使世界贸易增长放缓。

examples.en: The report blamed protectionism for higher consumer prices.
examples.cn: 报告把消费价格上涨归咎于保护主义。

examples.en: Small economies suffer most when protectionism spreads.
examples.cn: 保护主义蔓延时，小经济体受损最重。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「给本国产业加一道护墙」——protect 是保护，加上主义，就是用关税与规则筑墙 → 保护主义

root: protect 出自拉丁 protegere「在前面遮盖」= pro-（在前）+ tegere「遮盖」；-ism 经法语与拉丁语来自希腊 -ismos，指学说与体系。合指庇护本国产业、限制外国竞争的政策主张。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe one shield in different forms: the general policy, tariffs, non-tariff rules, a single sector, a political movement, disguised technical rules, services and procurement, and finally the costs critics attach to it.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项描述同一面盾牌的不同形态：总体政策、关税、非关税规则、单一行业、政治运动、伪装的技术规则、服务与采购，最后是批评者所附的代价。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall around home factories while foreign cargo waits outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：本国工厂外筑起高墙，外国货物在墙外等待。

branches.en: BASE SHIELD: a covering is placed before domestic producers.
branches.cn: 基础盾牌：在本国生产者之前放上一层遮蔽。

branches.en: PRICE WALL: duties make foreign goods dearer.
branches.cn: 价格之墙：关税使外国货更贵。

branches.en: PAPER WALL: quotas, licences and standards do the same work quietly.
branches.cn: 纸面之墙：配额、许可与标准悄悄做同样的事。

branches.en: ORGANIZED INTEREST: a sector or a movement campaigns for the shield.
branches.cn: 有组织的利益：某个行业或一场运动为这面盾牌奔走。

branches.en: EXPANDED AND COSTED: the shield reaches services and tenders, and carries a bill.
branches.cn: 扩展与代价：盾牌伸到服务与招标，并附带一张账单。

intro.en: Protectionism is a Latin verb of covering turned into a doctrine by a Greek-derived suffix.
intro.cn: protectionism 是一个拉丁表示遮盖的动词，被一个希腊来源的后缀变成一种主张。

latinIntro.en: Latin tegere 'to cover' gives protect, protection, protective, protector and detect; Greek -ismos gives the suffix -ism.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tegere「遮盖」衍生 protect、protection、protective、protector 与 detect；希腊 -ismos 提供后缀 -ism。

items.example: The prefix places the covering ahead.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把遮蔽物放在前面。

items.example: The root builds words of covering.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根构成一批表示遮盖的词。

items.example: A protector of local jobs spoke.
items.exampleCN: 一位本地就业的保护者发了言。
这个后缀为政治阵营命名。

items.example: Protectionism raised the price of steel.

items.exampleCN: 保护主义者阻挠了该条约。
